tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /'jam dpal rdo rje 'jigs mdzad kyi man ngag rwa lo'i snyan rgyud thun mong ma yin pa bzhugs/

shin tu gsang ba'i bka' rgya yod/ oṃ swā sti/ chos kuna~X sgrib med gzigs pa mkhyen pa'i gter/ /legs bshad dga~X' ston 'gyed la mthu grub pas/ /dam chos rgya mtsho'i snyinga~X po~X gsal mdzad pa/ khyab bdag bla mas rtag tu shis par mdzod/ /'jam dpal thugs kyi rdo rje gshin rje gshed/ /mi bzad khro bo chen po 'jigs pa'i sku/ /ye shes me lce 'bar ba'i 'od dpung gis/ /bdud sde 'jom byed bhai ra wa yis skyongs/ /rtog bdun brjod bya'i snying po'i don/ /rwa lo'i thugs bcud rmad byung ba/ /snyan nas snyan du brgyud pa yi/ /zhal gdams bla ma'i gsung bzhin 'bri/ /'dir dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed chen po'i thun mong ma yin pa'i zhal gyi gdams pa la/ bsnyen pa dang rjes su 'brel ba'i zhal gdams dang*/ sgrub pa dang rjes su 'brel ba'i zhal gdams dang*/ las sbyor dang rjes su 'brel ba'i zhal gdams dang gsum mo/ /dang po la/ thun mong bskyed rim gyi zhal gdams dang*/ thun mong ma yin pa mchog gi bsnyen pa'i zhal gdams dang gnyis las/ dang po la/ tshogs zhing gi skabs su dkyus nas 'byung ba ltar/ bla ma mi bskyod pas dbu rgyan pa'i rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi dkyil 'khor la/ bla ma steng gi cha la sgom pa dang*/ rigs bdag gi tshul du bsgom pa ma yin par/ rtsa ba'i bla ma dang ngo bo dbyer med pa 'khor lha bcu gsum mam dgu'am brgyad kyis bskaur ba dang*/ gzhan yang sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor badz+ra sa ma dzaḥ zhes spyan drangs/ a mṛ ta'i sngags sam/ ya man+ta kas= phyir 'brang gi bgegs bskrad cing byur dang bkra mi shis pa thams cad bsangs shing sbyangs bar bsam pa ni/ thun mong ma yin pa'i zhal gyi gdams pa dang po'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ rgyun bshags yan lag bdun pa'i skabs/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ /zhes pa dang*/ sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs mchog la/ /byang chub bar du bdag skyabs mchi/

/zhes pa'i skabs su thun mong ma yin pa'i dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba ste/ mdun gyi bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'jigs byed chen po ni/ sangs rgyas dkon mchog dang*/ rtsa sngags dang snying po/ nye snying la sogs pa'i sngags rnams ni chos dkon mchog dang*/ thun mong ma yin pa'i 'khor rnams ni dge 'dun dkon mchog ste/ de rnams yid yul du 'char bar byas te/ de rnams la skyabs su 'gro ba ni/ thun mong ma yin pa'i zhal gdams gnyis pa'o/ /mthar tshogs zhing rnams gshegs su gsol ba dang*/ mi dmigs par sbyangs pa dang*/ rang la bstim pa la sogs pa'i lugs du ma yod kyang*/ skabs 'dir rang la bsdu ba gtso che la/ 'di ni thun mong ma yin pa'i zhal gdams ma yin kyang 'phros don gyi tshul du gsung ngo*/ / gsum pa ni/ thun mong pa la bsrung 'khor gyi nang du chos 'byung sgom pa yin kyang*/ thun mong ma yin pa'i skabs 'dir bsrung 'khor gyi phyi rol tu chos 'byung sgom pa yin la/ de yang mchog sgrub pa la chos 'byung gru gsum phyi dkar la nang dmar ba/ drag po'i las la chos 'byung gru gsum nag po/ me rab tu 'bar ba bsgom pa ni/ thun mong ma yin pa'i zhal gdams gsum pa'o/ /chos 'byung bsrung 'khor thod ra dang bcas pa bsgom pa'i tshul ni/ chos 'byung gi phyi rol tu bsrung 'khor bsgom pa la ni/ slar yang chos 'byung gi nang du rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ de'i steng du phyi rol tu dur khrod dang*/ de las cung zad kyi dma' bar khrag gi rgya mtsho dang*/ de'i dbus su rin po che'i ri bo kha dog nag po khrag mtsho dang*/ dur khrod las cung zad kyi mtho bar gyur pa'i steng du thod ra bsgom mo/ /chos 'byung gi nang du bsrung 'khor sgom pa'i rigs la dmigs pa ni/ chos 'byung gi nang du bsrung 'khor gyi rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ phyi rol phyogs kun tu rdo rje'i ra ba zlum por bskor ba'i nang gi 'khor yug tu dur khrod chen po brgyad dang*/

de las cung zad kyi dma' ba'i nang du khrag gi rgya mtsho'i bskor ba/ de'i dbus su rin po che'i ri bo'i steng du thod ra bsgom mo/ /bzhi pa ni/ thod ra'i nang du yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor dbyibs zlum po/ du ba 'thul bar byed pa kha dog nag po/ rlung nag 'tshub ma'i rnam par bsgom zhing de las kyang phyogs kun tu rlung nag 'tshub ma'i rnam pa dpag tu med pa spraus pas sdang bar byed pa'i dgra/ gnod par byed pa'i bgegs thams cad phyogs kun tu gtor te lhag ma tsam yang med par brlag par bsam pa ni/ thun mong ma yin pa'i zhal gyi gdams pa bzhi pa'o/ /lnga pa ni/ rgyu'i 'jam dpal sgom pa'i bar sgrub thabs kyi dkyus nas 'byung ba bzhin byas la/ de'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas de bzhin gshegs pa rigs lnga khrau bo'i rnam pa dang*/ de bzhin gshegs ma rnams kyang khro mo'i nyams dang bcas shing*/ byang chub sems dpa' yang khro bo'i rnam par spyan drangs te/ 'jam dpal gdan dang bcas pa nyi ma la thim par sgom/ nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor las kyang tsha zer 'bar ba dpag tu med pa phyogs kun tu spros pas/ dgra bgegs spyi dang*/ dmigs gsal can gyi dgra bgegs thams cad thal ba tsam yang ma lus par bsregs par bsam pa ni thun mong ma yin pa'i zhal gdams lnga pa'o/ /drug pa ni/ yang de'i 'od zer gyis/ ā li kā li dang sngags 'phreng rnams rang rang gi sgra 'brug ltar sgrog pa dpag tu med pa spyan drangs te nyi ma la bstims pas/ hūṃ nag po 'od zer 'phros pa'i bar tsam zhig gsal 'debs pa'i bar dkyus bzhin las/ hūṃ zhes pa'i sgra 'brug stong ldir ba lta bu'i sgras phyogs thams cad khyab par bsam zhing*/ sgra des ber langs pa lta bur gyur te/ dgra bgegs thams cad kyi gnas rnams zhig cing shin tu skrag pas brgyal bar gyur par bsam/ yang hūṃ las dug gi sprin nam mkha' gang ba spros te de las nad dang dug chu'i char ba dpag tu med pa byung nas dgra bgegs thams cad rul myags shing bsngos pas rdul du brlag par bsam pa ni/

thun mong ma yin pa'i zhal gdams drug pa'o/ /bdun pa ni/ 'od zer 'phros pas phyag mtshan rnams spyan drangs la bstims pas/ hūṃ de nyid rdo rje mthing nag rwa gdengs pa 'od zer 'phro ba sgom pa'i bar dkyus bzhin las/ rdo rje de las khro chung dang*/ phyag mtshan gyi tshogs dpag tu med pa spros pas phyag mtshan me 'bar ba rnams kyis dgra bgegs thams cad tshar bcad cing khro chung rnams kyis sems can thams cad kyang rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi sku'i rnam par bsgyur cing go 'phang la bkod/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi rnam par gyur te rdo rje la thim par bsgom pa ni/ thun mong ma yin pa'i zhal gdams bdun pa'o/ /brgyad pa ni/ de nas rang nyid 'bras bu rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi sku'i rnam par lam gyis grub par bsam ste/ nyung mtha' la yang*/ hrīḥ ṣ+tiḥ bdun tsam gyis sngags kyi lhar sgrub pa ni/ thun mong ma yin pa'i zhal gdams brgyad pa'o/ /dgu pa ni/ zhal phyag gsal 'debs dkyus bzhin las/ sku las sprul pa'i pho nya spro ba'i skabs su/ nges pa'i 'khor dang*/ ma nges pa'i 'khor gnyis las/ dang po la mngags pa dang*/ pho nya gnyis las/ dang po ni/ srin po dang*/ mkha' 'gro ma gnyis/ gnyis pa ni/ gshin rje dang*/ ma mo gnyis so/ /de rnams spro ba'i tshul ni/ mar me las/ mar me'i 'od bzhin du/ rang nyid 'jigs byed chen po'i skur gsal ba'i snang cha las dur khrod chen po brgyad du/ srin po dang*/ mkha' 'gro ma dang/ gshin rje dang ma mo ste/ de rnams gsal 'debs pa ni/ srin po brgyad g.yas ral gri dang*/ g.yon thod khrag 'dzin pa/ yang na g.yas kyi phyag mtshan gri gug dang 'dam kha yin kyang*/ phyag len la ral gri gtso che bar mdzad de/ srin po'i zhal du dgra bgegs thams cad chom chom gsol bas zhal mchil dmar po thor thor 'thor bar bsam/ mkha' 'gro ma brgyad ni/ g.yas gri khug dang*/

g.yon thod khrag 'dzin pa/ gshin rje brgyad ni g.yas ral gri dang*/ g.yon zhags pa 'dzin pa/ de'i yum ma mo brgyad ni/ g.yas rtse gsum dang*/ g.yon thod khrag 'dzin pa/ de rnams thams cad kyang sku mdog nag por bsgom mo/ /gnyis pa ni/ ma nges pa'i 'khor ni/ bran pho mo ste/ thams cad kyang sku mdog ma nges pa/ mgo brnyan sna tshogs pa'i rnam pa/ sku dang gzhal yas khang dang*/ dur khrod la sogs pa gnas ma nges pa nas phar 'phro ba dang*/ tshur gnas ma nges pa rnams su bsdu bar byed pa ni/ thun mong ma yin pa'i zhal gdams dgu pa'o/ /de nas dam tshig pa bskyed zin pa'i skabs dang*/ ye shes pa rang la bstim pa la sogs pa'i skabs su/ drag shul gyi nyams dang ldan pas/ ri rnams snyil zhing rgya mtsho drag tu 'khrugs pa dang*/ gza' skar thang la lhung ba la sogs pa gzi byin dang mthu stobs dpag tu med pa dang ldan par bsam/ mig tu k+ṣiṃḥ la sogs pa'i sa bon gyi yi ge de rnams sa'i snying po la sogs pa lha so so'i rang bzhin du mos/ spyi bor gnas pa'i oṃ yig rnam snang dang*/ rin 'byung gcig tu bsdus pa sku rdo rje dang mgrin pa'i āḥ yig 'od dpag med dang*/ don grub gcig tu 'dus pa gsung rdo rje dang*/ thugs ka'i hūṃ yig mi bskyod pa thugs rdo rje'i rang bzhin du mos so/ /bcu pa ni/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phraus/ rdo rje 'jigs byed sprul pa'i sku ri rab kyi rtse'am/ khong gseng na bzhugs pa de nyid skad cig nyid la mdun du spyan drangs/ gong tshogs zhing gi skabs ltar bsangs pa byas la/ oṃ hrīḥ ṣ+tiḥ haḥ zhes pa'am/ oṃ badz+ra lā s+ya hūṃ/ zhes pa'am/ ar+ghaṃ la sogs pa gang rung gis mchod pa las/ phyag len la phyi ma gtso che bar mdzad nas/ oṃ badz+ra aṃ gu sha dzaḥ zhes sogs sam/ bsdu na dzaḥ hūṃ baṃ hoḥ zhes pas rang la bstims pas bkrag mdangs gzi byin dpag tu med pa skyes par mos la/ brtan pa'i phyir du/

yā man+ta ka lan gsum sogs bzla ba ni/ zhal gdams bcu pa'o/ /bcu gcig pa ni/ yang snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang sems rnams rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi sku'i rnam par gyur pa rnams/ yā mān+ta ka'i sngags kyis 'jigs byed du sgrub la/ spyan 'dren pa/ bsangs pa/ mchod pa bstim pa'i bar sngar bzhin las/ rang nyid sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' kun 'dus su mos la/ brtan pa'i phyir du yā man+ta ka sngar bzhin bzla ba ni/ zhal gyi gdams pa bcu gcig pa'o/ /bcu gnyis pa ni/ sngar bzhin 'od zer spros pas gdod nas grub pa'i rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi sku nam mkha' khyab par bzhugs pa de nyid rang gi mdun tu mngon du gyur pa'i tshul gyis badz+ra sa ma dzaḥ spyan drangs/ bsangs pa/ mchod pa/ bstim pa rnams sngar bzhin byas/ rang nyid gdod nas grub pa'i longs sku rdo rje 'jigs byed dngos yin snyam du mos/ ya man+ta ka'i sngar bzhin brtan par byed pa ni/ zhal gyi gdams pa bcu gnyis pa'o/ /de yang ye shes spyan 'dren gyi zhal gdams gsum po 'di rnams la/ thog mtha' gnyis la spyan 'dren/ bsangs pa/ mchod pa/ bstim pa/ brtan par byed pa ste/ don tshan lnga lnga dang*/ bar ba la 'od zer gyis 'jigs byed kyi skur bsgyur ba sngar gyis lhar sgrub pa/ spyan 'dren pa/ bsangs pa/ mchod pa/ bstim pa brtan par byed pa ste/ don tshan bdun no/ /rang nyid 'jigs byed du gyur pa la/ mig tu k+ṣiṃ la sogs pa bkod pa'i tshe rgyud tha dad pa'i tshul gyis rang nyid bsrung ba'i phyir bkod pa yin la/ sprul sku rdo rje 'jigs byed bstim pa'i skabs su rang nyid 'jigs byed du gsal ba'i spyan dang phyag dang dbu la sogs pa rnams/ sprul sku rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi de dang de yin snyam pa'i nga rgyal bskyed do/ /sangs rgyas byang sems 'jigs byed kyi rnam par gyur pa rnams rang la bstim pa'i skabs su spyan la sogs pa'i sku lus kyi cha shas rnams/

sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad kyi de dang de yin snyam pa'i nga rgyal bskyed do/ /gdod nas grub pa'i gnas lugs chos nyid kyi longs sku rdo rje 'jigs byed bstim pa'i skabs su/ rang nyid rdo rje 'jigs byed du gsal ba'i sku gsung thugs rnams/ chos nyid gdod ma'i rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi sku gsung thugs dngos yin snyam pa'i nga rgyal bskyed do/ /bcu gsum pa ni/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas/ dbang gi lha rigs lnga/ yum bzhi/ byang chub sems dpa' brgyad/ lha mo drug rnams spyan 'dren pa las/ thams cad kyang khro bo'i rnam pa/ rigs lnga dang sems dpa' rnams g.yas rang rang gi phyag mtshan phyar ba/ g.yon rang rang gi phyag mtshan 'dzin pas/ so so'i yum khro nyams dang bcas pa la 'khyud pa/ zhabs g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang gi tshul gyi bzhugs par mdun du spyan drangs te bsang ba bya ba ni/ zhal gdams bcu gsum pa'o/ /de nas rigs bdag mi bskyod pas rgyas btab pa'i bar dkyus bzhin no/ /bcu bzhi pa ni/ dbang gi lha'i thugs ka nas 'od zer gtso bor spro zhing*/ rang gi snying ga nas kyang 'od zer dpag tu med pa spros pas 'khor 'das kyi snod bcud thams cad kyi bkrag mdangs bcud thams cad dang sangs rgyas byang sems rnams kyi sku'i byin rlabs 'od zer dkar po'i rnam par spyan drangs te/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ zhes pas rang la bstims pas/ rang nyid la gzi byin dpag tu med pa skyes par mos la/ oṃ yā man+ta ka hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ oṃ oṃ/ zhes bzla ba ni/ zhal gdams bcu bzhi pa'o/ /bco lnga pa ni/ dbang lha dang*/ rang gi snying ga nas 'or zer 'phros pas 'khor 'das kyi snod bcud thams cad kyi mdangs dang*/ ye shes mi shigs pa'i bcud rnams dang*/ sangs rgyas byang sems kyi gsung gi byin rlabs 'od zer dmar po'i rnam par spyan drangs te/ rang la bstims pas sngar bas kyang gzi byin 'phel bar bsam la/

yā mān+ta ka'i mthar/ āḥ.āḥ.āḥ zhes bzla ba ni/ zhal gdams bco lnga pa'o/ /bcu drug pa ni/ dbang lha dang rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ 'khor 'das snod bcud thams cad kyi mdangs dang*/ bcud rnams dang sangs rgyas byang sems kyi thugs kyi byin rlabs rnams 'od zer sngon po'i rnam par spyan drangs te bstim pas/ gzi byin lhag par 'phel bar bsam la/ yā man+ta ka'i mthar/ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ/ zhes bzla ba ni/ zhal gdams bcu drug pa'o/ /bcu bdun pa ni/ dbang gi lha'i thugs ka nas dang*/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas/ 'khor 'das kyi snod bcud thams cad kyi bkrag mdangs spyi dang*/ khyad par rang rang so so'i yon tan/ dper na sa'i yon tan sra ba dang*/ de bzhin du chu'i brlan gsher dang*/ me'i drod dang*/ rlung gi yon tan g.yo ba la sogs pa rnams dang*/ sems can so so'i yon tan gyi khyad par rnams dang*/ sangs rgyas byang sems kyi sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs dang*/ yon tan gyi khyad par sna tshogs pa rnams te/ mdor na 'khor 'das kyi brtan g.yo thams cad kyi thabs snang ba'i cha thams cad 'od zer ser po'i rnam par spyan drangs shing*/ de dang lhan cig tu rgyan dang*/ na bza'i khyad par mang po yang tshur bsdus/ rang la bstims pas 'od zer rnams rang la thim zhing*/ na bza' rnams glang lpags la thim/ rgyan gyi khyad par rnams sku'i rgyan cha rnams la thim pas/ rgyan rnams kyang 'od 'bar zhing 'phro ba'i rnam pa dang*/ rang nyid kyi gzi byin yang lhag par rgyas par bsam zhing*/ mchod yon/ me tog /bdug spos/ snang gsal/ dri mchog /zhal zas sogs mchod pa'i khyad par sna tshogs pa rang nyid la 'byung bar bsam la/ ya mān+ta ka'i mthar/ swā swā swā/ zhes bzla ba ni/ zhal gdams bcu bdun pa'o/ /bco brgyad pa ni/ dbang lha dang*/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas/ 'khor 'das kyi brtan g.yo thams cad kyi mdangs dang*/

bcud rnams dang*/ khyad par du yang de dag gi shes rab stong pa'i cha rnams 'od zer ljang gu'i rnam par spyan drangs shing*/ de dag dang lhan cig tu gri gug la sogs pa mtshon cha sna tshogs pa yang bkug ste/ rang nyid la bstims pa las/ 'od zer rnams rang gi sku lus la thim pas gzi byin sngar las kyang lhag par rgyas/ mtshon cha rnams phyag mtshan so so la thim pas/ phyag mtshan rnams kyang me lce 'bar bar gyur par bsam la/ rang nyid la khrag gi mchod yon/ dbang po lnga'i me togasha chen gyi bdug spos/ zhun chen gyi snang gsal/ mkhris pa'i dri chab/ sha khrag gi zhal zas/ zhing chen gyi bla re/ rgyu rlon gyi lda ldi sogs drag po'i mchod pa sna tshogs pa byung bar bsam la/ ya mān+ta ka'i mthar/ hā hā hā/ zhes bzla ba ni zhal gdam bco brgyad pa'o/ /bcu dgu pa ni/ dbang gi lha'i thugs ka nas 'od zer dpag tu med pa spros/ 'khor 'das snod bcud rnams kyi spros bral stong ba'i cha rnams 'od zer sngon po'i rnam par spyan drangs shing*/ de dang lhan cig tu tshangs pa dang brgya byin la sogs pa 'jig rten na mthu dang stobs che bar gyur pa'i skye 'gro rnams bkug ste/ zhabs 'og gi srog chags rnams la bstim/ 'od zer rnams rang la thim pas gzi byin dpag tu med pa rgyas par mos la/ ya mān+ta ka'i mthar/ hi hi hi/ zhes bzla ba ni zhal gdams bcu dgu pa'o/ /nyi shu pa ni/ de nas rang gi snying ga nas phag mo dang dbyangs can ma dang*/ ro langs ma dang rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma ste bzhi po gang rung zhig rjes chags kyi don du spro ba yin pa las/ phag mo dang*/ dbyangs can ma gnyis dgra nag nas 'byung ba ltar/ zhal gsum phyag drug ma dang*/ rdo rje ro langs ma zhal gsum phyag drug ma'am/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma gang rung du bsgom zhing*/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma ni dgra nag nas 'byung ba ltar/ zhal gsum phyag drug mar bsgom mo/ /de ltar rang gi snying ga nas lha mo bzhi po gang rung zhig 'khor sgeg sogs lha mo brgyad dang bcas pa spros/

thabs shes kyi mkha' gsang byin gyis brlabs la/ rang nyid la yum bzhi po gang rung zhig gis 'khyud par bsam la/ sgeg sogs lha mo brgyad po rnams kyang*/ mtha' skor du glu dang gar la sogs pa chags pa'i rol rtsed sna tshogs pa byed par mos la/ rang nyid yab yum snyoms par zhugs pas dga' bzhi'i ye shes skyes par mos la oṃ āḥhūṃ oṃ sarba tā tha ga ta a nu rā ga na sogs brjod pa ni gsang ba'i mchod pa ste/ zhal gdams nyi shu pa'o/ /de nas gzugs sgra la sogs drug po ni/ /zhes sogs 'don bzhin pas rjes chags kyis bde ba dang*/ lha mo'i rol rtsed sogs snang stong rgyu ma lta bur shes par byas nas/ snying ga nas spros pa de dag slar rang gi snying gar bsdu'o/ / dkyus nas 'byung ba bzhin gyi bstod pas bstod cing*/ rang nyid la phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang sems rnams kyis brag cha lta bu'i sgras bstod par bsam mo/ /bdud rtsi myang ba dkyus nas 'byung ba ltar byed do/ /nyer gcig pa ni/ rang nyid 'jigs byed chen por gsal ba'i mdun du 'brub khung zhig gsal gdab/ hrīḥ ṣ+tiḥ 'i mthar dmigs gsal can gyi dgra yod na/ ming nas smos la a kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ zhes pa dang*/ de lta bur med na sarba sha trun a kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ zhes brjod pas zhabs 'og gi srog chags rnams las pho nya'i tshogs dpag tu med pa spros te/ dmigs kyis gsal ba'i dgra yod na de nyid bkug cing*/ de lta bu med na phyogs bcu'i gdug pa can kun bkug nas/ thams cad kyang gcig tu 'dus par gyur te/ 'brub khung gi nang du bcug par mos la/ dzaḥhūṃ bam̐ hoḥ zhes brjod do/ /de nas rang gi snying ga nas sku stod rdo rje 'jigs byed phyag gnyis pa'i rnam pa can la/ smad phur ba'i dbyibs can spros la/ hrīḥ ṣ+tiḥ 'i mthar sarba sha trun kī la ya hūṃ phaṭa/ ces pa gsum bzhi tsam brjod pas/ dgra bo'i lus sems phral zhing dbang chen gser gyi sa gzhi la sgrag par bsam/

de nas hrīḥ ṣ+ti'i mthar sarba sha truṃ tshin+dha tshin+dha bin+dha bin+dha mā ra ya hūṃ phaṭa/ ces lan gsum mam bzhi tsam brjod pas/ mtshon cha sna tshogs thogs pa'i pho nya drag gtum rnams kyi dgra bgegs kyi lus rnams dum bur gtub pas/ phyi nang thams cad du sha khrag gi tshogs thod pa'i snod dang*/ mi lpags kyi g.yang bzhi'i snod rnams su dpag tu med pa byung bar bsam/ de lta bu'i sha khrag gi tshogs pa rnams 'jigs byed chen po'i zhal dgu po rnams nas 'od zer gyi sbu gus drangs te/ sha chom rus chom du gsol bar bsam zhing*/ nges pa dang ma nges pa'i 'khor rnams dang*/ zhabs 'og gi srog chags rnams kyis kyang hab thob tu khyer zhing gsol bar mos la/ hrīḥ ṣ+tiḥ 'i mthar badz+ra bhai ra wa a dhi pa ti e dam ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ ces pa lan gsum brjod do/ /de ni drag po'i mchod pa ste/ zhal gdams nyer gcig pa'o/ /nyi shu rtsa gnyis pa ni/ zhi khro sbrags sgrub byed pa ste/ drag po'i mchod pa grub rjes su rang nyid kyi thugs ka'i rgyu'i 'jam dpal gnas gyur te/ 'jam dbyangs dkar po zhal bzhi phyag brgyad pa zhal bzhi ka dkar po/ phyag dang po gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ de'i 'og ma gnyis kyis ral gri dang po ti 'dzin pa/ de'i 'og ma gnyis kyis mda' dang zhu 'dzin pa/ de'i 'og ma gnyis kyi lcags kyu dang zhags pa 'dzin pas/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ yum shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin ma sku mdog dmar mo gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pas yab la 'khyud pa/ 'jam dbyangs kyi thugs kar zla ba la dhīḥ dkar po/ yum gyi thugs kar nyi ma la hrīḥ dmar po/ dhīḥ yi mthar rtsa sngags snying po nye snying rnams kyis bskor bar dmigs la/ hrīḥ dhīḥ zhes pa lan kha yar bzlas pa'i mthar ya mān+ta ka /hrīḥ ṣ+tīḥ ya ma ra dzaḥ rnams bzla'o/

/sngags 'phreng las bdud rtsi dmar po rlan gsher drod kyi rang bzhin can dpag tu med pa byung*/ 'jam dpal gyi sku lus gang*/ ba spu'i bu ga nas byung*/ snying ga chos kyi 'khor lo gang rtsa stong phrag bdun cu rtsa gnyis nas brgyud/ rang nyid rdo rje'i 'jigs byed kyi sku lus thams cad gang*/ dri nan nag po dang sdig sgrib thams cad bkrus shing sbyangs/ dwangs gsal 'od kyi rang bzhin dag pa'i shel ltar gyur/ bdud rtsi rnams rim gyi 'dus/ 'jam dpal gyi ba spu'i bu ga nas 'dus/ thugs ka'i dhiḥl thim/ de lta bu'i dmigs pa la sems gtad nas bzlas pa bya'o/ /zhi khro sbrags sgrub kyi bsnyain pa byed pa'i skabs de kho na la dmigs pa gtod cing*/ rgyun gyi nyams len la ni/ thog mar zhi khro sbrags sgrub kyi dmigs pa dang*/ bzlas pa cung zad byas la/ sems dpa' gsum brtsegs dkyus bzhin du sgom la bzla par bya'o/ /zhi khro sbrags sgrub kyi dmigs pa de la brten nas shes rab 'phel bar byed na/ 'jam dbyangs kyi thugs kar nghīḥ yig mthar/ oṃ badz+ra tik+ṣa na dhiḥ zhes pa'i sngags kyis bskor bar bsam zhing*/ de rnams las 'od zer dkar po'i tshogs dpag tu med pa 'phros/ 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi sku lus thams cad gang*/ ba spu'i bu ga nas phyir 'phros/ rang nyid kyi lus kyi nang thams cad gang ba spu'i bu ga nas phyir 'phros pas/ me ri dang 'dres te 'od zer gyi tshogs rnams kyis mi shes pa'i mun pa bsal/ shes rab kyi snang ba la bkod/ sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa'i mkhyen pa rnams 'od zer gyi rnam par bsdus te/ rang gi snying ga'i sngags 'phreng la thim par bsam la/ gong gi sngags de bzla'o/ /yang dbang sdud kyi dmigs pa ni/ sku mdog dmar po bsgyur/ bsdu na g.yas lcags kyu dang g.yon zhags pa 'dzin pa bskyed/ rgyan dang yum sogs sngar bzhin bsgom/ 'jam dbyangs kyi thugs kar dhīḥyi mthar/

oṃ ma hā ra ga badz+ra ra ga ya sarba satwa na hoḥ zhes pas bskor bar dmigs/ yang na yab kyi thugs kar zla ba'i steng du dhīḥ yig dmar pos mtha' bskor du/ oṃ mañdzu shrī wa shaṃ ku ru hrī dzaḥ zhes pa kha dog dmar pos bskor bar bsgom/ de nas sngags bzlas pas 'od zer dmar po dpag tu med pa byung*/ 'jam dpal gy-i sku lus gang*/ ba spu'i bu ga nas phyir byung*/ rang nyid 'jigs byed kyi sku lus gang*/ ba spu'i bu ga nas phyir 'phros 'od zer gyi rtse mo la pho nya drag gtum dpa' ba rtul phod dang bcas pa'i nyams can/ lcags kyu dang zhags pa thogs pa dpag tu med pa spros/ dbang du bsdu rgyu'i bsgrub bya pho mo gang yin thams cad zhags pas bcings/ lcags kyus skyes pa'i snying kha dang*/ bud med kyi gsang ba nas phug ste skad cig nyid la drangs nas/ rang gi zhabs gnyis kyi bar ram mdun du nyi ma'i steng du bkug /de dag thams cad gan rkyal nas brgyal ba dang*/ myos pa'i rnam pa can gsal btab/ rang gi thugs ka nas 'od zer dmar po 'phros/ de dag la phog pas lus kyi nang thams cad 'od dmar pos gang bas/ rang la shin tu dga' ba dang gus pa dang dad pa'i rnam pas/ thal mo sbyar nas 'dug par bsam/ sngags bzlas nas thun 'jog pa'i tshe de dag de nyid du mi dmigs par bsam pa ma gtogs phar spro ba sogs mi dgos so/ /yang 'jam dbyangs yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i byang chub kyi sems sbyor mtshams nas babs/ snying ga'i rtsa bzhi nas rim gyis brgyud/ lus thams cad khrig mer te gang bar bsam la gong gi sngags de bzla'o/ /de rnams ni zhi khro sbrags sgrub kyi gdams pa ste/ zhal gdams nyer gnyis pa'o/ /nyer gsum pa ni/ srog sgrub ste/ de yang rang gi snying khar lha mo dbyangs can ma sku mdog dmar mo/ dmar nag dkar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi dang po gnyis kyis gri gug dang thod pa khrag gis gang ba'am/ mgo bo ril bo 'dzin pa/

g.yas gnyis kyis po tis mtshan pa'i pad+ma dang*/ 'khor lo dang*/ g.yon gnyis kyi ri po ches mtshan pa'i pi waṃ dang ral gri 'dzin pa/ zhabs g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang gi stabs kyis bzhugs pa stag lpags kyi shams thabs sogs zhi ma khro'i rnam par gsal btab/ de'i thugs kar nyi ma la sa bon hrīḥ yig gam/ do yig /de'i mthar/ oṃ pi tsu pi tsu pradzñā war+dha ni/ dz+wa la dz+wa la me dha war+dha ni/ dhi ri dhi ri/ bud+dhi war+dha ni ye swāhā/ zhes pa rnams kha dog dmar por dmigs la/ de las 'od zer dkar po'i tshogs dpag tu med pa spros/ dbyangs can ma'i ba spu'i bu ga nas thon/ rang gi lus kyi nang thams cad gang*/ ba spu'i bu ga nas phyir spros me ri dang 'dres pa'i me 'od kyis sems can rnams kyi mi shes pa'i mun pa bsal/ sangs rgyas kyi byin rlabs rnams mkhyen pa'i ngo bor spyan drangs te snying ga'i sngags 'phreng la thim par bsam la/ gong gi sngags bzla bar byed pa ni/ shes rab 'phel bar byed pa'o/ /dbang sdud kyi dmigs pa ni/ snying ga'i sngags 'phreng las 'od zer dmar po'i tshogs spros/ dbyangs can ma dang rang gi ba spu'i bu ga nas phyir spros/ khams gsum thams cad dbang du bsdus/ sangs rgyas kyi byin rlabs rnams 'od zer dmar po'i rnam par spyan drangs te/ rang gi snying ga'i sngags 'phreng la thim par bsam la/ gong gi sngags bzla'o/ /rgyud 'jam par byed pa ni/ rang gi snying gar dbyangs can ma dang*/ dbyangs can ma'i thugs ka'i sngags 'phreng sngar bzhin gsal btab la/ sngags 'phreng las byang chub kyi sems kyi rgyun byung sku lus kyi nang thams cad gang*/ gsang gnas nas thon/ rang gi lus kyi nang thams cad gang zhing bkrus pas/ nyams bde ba dang ldan par mos la/ gong gi sngags bzla'o/ /thugs rgyud bskul ba ni/ rang gi lte bar dbyangs can ma/ de'i gsang gnas su chos 'byung gru gsum gyi nang du nyi ma la hūṃ de'i mthar nye snying snying po rtsa sngags rnams kyi bskor ba/

rang gi snying khar nyi ma la dbyangs can ma'i sa bon dang*/ sngags 'phreng gis bskor ba las 'od zer dmar po'i tshogs dpag tu med pa byung*/ lte ba na bzhugs pa'i dbyangs can ma'i gsang gnas kyi sngags 'phreng la thim pas/ thugs rgyud rang dbang med par bskul bar bsam mo/ / gsang gnas kyi sngags las kyang 'od zer 'phros/ thugs ka'i yi ge la thim/ de rnams ni srog bsgrub ste/ zhal gyi gdams pa thun mong ma yin pa nyer gsum pa'o/ /nyer bzhi pa ni/ thun mong ma yin pa'i bsrung ba ste/ de yang nyin bsrung ba ni rang nyid 'jigs byed du gsal ba'i lus kyi g.yon sked pa tsam/ mtsher ba'i gnas su gshin rje sku mdog nag po/ g.yas ral gri dang*/ g.yon phub 'dzin pa/ spyan gsum stag lpags dang sbrul rgyan sogs/ khro bo'i rgyan dang cha lugs yongs su rdzogs pa'i sku can zhig gsal btab la/ oṃ ya ma ma tha na hūṃ phaṭa/ ces pa'i sngags 'di mang nyung ci rigs pa bzla'o/ /dus kyi khyad par skya rengs shar ba tsam la bsngags par bshad do/ /mtshan bsrung ni/ sngar gyi gnas su gshin rje sku mdog nag po/ g.yas ral gri/ g.yon phub 'dzin pa/ rmogs sog go chas brgyan pa/ 'jig rten pa'i cha lugs can zhig dmigs la/ oṃ hrīḥkā la ru pa hūṃ khaṃ zhes pa mang nyung ci rigs pa bzla'o/ khyad par can gyi dus ni mun tshab tshub la'o/ /de gnyis ka la'ang rab tu 'bar ba'i spyan steng 'og thams cad du gzigs pa/ spyan gsum las me lce'i tshogs dpag tu med pa spros pas/ rang nyid rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi sku lus kyi nang thams cad gang bar bsam mo/ /de gnyis ni 'jig rten pa'i gshin rje gshed kyi bsrung ba yin la/ 'jig rten las 'das pa'i bsrung ba ni/ rang gi lus kyi g.yas phyogs/ mchin pa'i gnas su gshin rje de/ g.yas rdo rjes mtshan pa'i be con dang*/ g.yon zhags pa 'dzin pa/ sku las me 'od 'phros pas/ lus kyi nang thams cad gang bar bsam la/

oṃ hrīḥkruṃ bruṃ sruṃ s+t+ruṃ hūṃ gzhes pa brgya rtsa la sogs pa ci rigs pa bzla'o/ /zhal gdams nyer bzhi pa'o/ /nyer lnga pa ni/ las gshin gyi sgrub thabs ni/ snying ga nas spro ba dang*/ spyan 'dren pa gnyis las dang po ni/ rang gi snying ga nas yi ge yaḥ gcig spros/ mdun du las kyi gshin rje sku mdog sngon po/ g.yas dbyug pa dang*/ g.yon zhags pa 'dzin pa/ khro zhal spyan gsum pa/ sbrul rgyan dang*/ stag lpags grol ba'am/ gcer bu ling ga gyen du bsgreng ba'i rnam pa can du gsal btab/ de g.yon du yum tsa mun ṭi rtse gsum dang thod khrag 'dzin pa'i rnam pa can skad cig tsam gyis gsal btab la/ sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ zhes dam la bzhag /mchod bstod bya/ rang nyid 'jigs byed du gsal ba'i yi dam gyi sngags 'phreng gi mthar/ las gshin gyi sngags kyis bskor bar dmigs la/ thog mar yi dam gyi sngags dang*/ de'i rjes su chos kyi rgyal po'i rtog pa las byung ba'i sngags ring de lan bdun brgyad tsam bzlas la/ de nas/ ya mā kā la ru pa hūṃ phaṭa ta a zhes pa bzlas la/ rang gi snying ga'i sa bon sngags 'phreng dang bcas pa las 'od zer dkar po'i tshogs dpag tu med pa spros/ las kyi gshin rje yab yum la phog pas/ rang gi 'gal rkyen bar chad thams cad zhi ba dang*/ las gshin 'khor bcas kyi rang la 'tshub pa dang 'khu ldog gi rnam pa thams cad zhi zhing mthu stobs dang gzi byin dpag tu med pa rgyas par bsam la/ mtha' bskor du rang la bskaur ba byed par mos so/ /yang snying ga'i sngags 'phreng las 'od zer dmar po'i tshogs dpag tu med pa spros/ las kyi gshin rje la phog pas rang gi dbang du 'dus shing bran bzhin du bka' nyan par bsam mo/ /yang snying ga'i sa bon sngags 'phreng dang bcas pa las 'od zer sngon po'i tshogs dpag tu med pa spros/ las kyi gshin rje la phog pas rang la sdang bar byed pa'i dgra/ gnod par byed pa'i bgegs thams cad tshar gcod pa la sogs pa drag po'i las thams cad thogs med du sgrub pa'i las mdzad par bsam la mtha' skor du bskor ba mdzad par mos so/

/de nas thun gyi mthar las gshin gyi gtor bsngo'am/ yi dam gyi gtor ma'i zhor la gtor ma phul la/ rang gi lte bar yi ge yaḥ gcig gsal btab la/ de la las gshin yum dang bcas pa bsdu'o/ /gnyis pa spyan 'dren pa ni/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas lho phyogs rim pa bdun gyi sa 'og nas las kyi gshin rje spyan drangs la/ a mṛ tas sngags sam/ ya man+ta kas bsang ba bya/ gzhan sngar bzhin las/ mthar gshegs su gsol/ de ni zhal gdams nyer lnga pa'o/ /nyer drug pa 'khor lo'i bsnyen pa ni/ rang gi lte ba'i nang 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad pa/ de'i phyi bskor rtsibs bcu gnyis/ de'i phyi bskor du drug cu re bzhi rnams su yod pa las/ de rnams yongs su gyur pa las/ 'khor lo nang bskor la re mig brgyad/ de'i phyi la re mig bcu gnyis/ de'i phyi la re mig bcu drug ste/ thams cad kyi bar rnams rtsig pa 'then pa lta bu la thog phub byed na lcags mkhar sgo med dang*/ thog phub mi byed na 'brub khung lta bu'o/ /re mig gi dbus su yaḥ yig dang*/ shar nas g.yas bskor du/ k+ṣe ma me da dang*/ phyi bskor gyi re mig bcu gnyis la/ dzaḥs do ru ṇa yo ni ra yats+tsha ni ra/ zhes pa rnams 'god pa yin pa las/ de yang lho ma'i thad du ra dang de nas dzaḥsogs g.yas bskor du bkod/ phyi'i re mig la/ oṃ dang hrīḥgacig tu byas na na gnyis gcig tu byas pa'i snying po'i sngags 'god cing*/ yig 'bru med pa'i re mig stong pa rnams su/ gti mug gi sa bon maṃ dang*/ ser sna'i sa bon baṃ dang*/ 'dod chags kyi sa bon taṃ dang*/ phrag dog gi sa bon i baṃ dang*/ zhe sdang gi sa bon daṃ rnams las byung ba'i bdud bzh-i'i rnam pa can gyi bgegs dang dgra ste gnas par bsam la/ 'jam rlung bzung zhing 'gog bzlas kyi tshul gyis/ oṃ ya ma rā dza sa do me ya hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ya me do ru ṇa yo da ya hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ya da yo ni ra yak+ṣe ya hūṃ phaṭa/

oṃ yak+ṣe yats+tsha ni ra ma ya hūṃ phaṭa/ ces rtsa sngags dum bu bzhir byas te bzla ba yin pa las/ dmigs pa ni yig 'bru rnams las me lce dang pho nya dpag tu med pa spros/ re mig stong pa rnams la yod pa'i dgra bgegs thams cad tshar bcad par bsam mo/ /grangs ni khri phrag lnga tsam zla ba yin pa las/ thun re la sngags tshan re re byas te bzla ba ni cung zad rtsub pa yin zhing*/ thog mar sngags tshan dang po khri phrag lnga 'gro bar byas la/ de nas rim pas tshan pa re re bzhin khri phrag lnga lnga bzla ba ni 'jam pa yin no/ /de bzhin du hrīḥṣ+tiḥbazla zhing re mig phyi ma la dmigs pa sngar bzhin gtad do/ /de ni gshin rje spyi'i 'khor lo'o/ /rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i 'khor lo la/ spyir rtog bdun las hrīḥṣ+tiḥrkyang ba'i 'khor lo dang*/ hrīḥṣ+tiḥdang ya ma rā dza sbrags pa'i 'khor lo ste gnyis po de gsal bar gsungs shing*/ hrīḥṣ+tiḥrkyang ba'i 'khor lo gsungs pa'i shugs la/ ya mān+ta ka dang*/ ya ma rā dza rkyang ba'i 'khor lo'ang bstan cing*/ hrīḥṣ+tiḥdang ya ma rā dza sbrags pa'i 'khor lo bstan pa'i shugs la/ hrīḥṣ+tiḥdang ya mān+ta ka sbrags pa dang*/ ya ma rā dza dang*/ ya man+ta ka sbrags pa'i 'khor lo dang*/ gsum char sbrags pa'i 'khor lo ste bdun yod pa las/ nang gi bsnyen pa'i skabs 'dir hrīḥṣ+tiḥdang*/ ya ma rā dza sbrags pa'i 'khor lo sgom par byed pa yin te/ de yang rang gi lte bar 'khor lo phyi brgyad nang brgyad/ re mig gi bar dang phyi nang gi mtshams la lcags ri 'then pa la/ thog phub mi byed na 'brub khung dang*/ thog phub byed na lcags mkhar du mos la/ lte bar yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor/ de'i steng du raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor raṃ gyis mtshan pa/ chos 'byung gnyis brtsegs kyi rnam pa can gyi steng du/ g.yas g.yon du raṃ re re/ de'i bar du ṇi dang dri gnod byed thams cad ces pa lta bu dang*/

dmigs gsal yod na dgra bgegs 'di zhes bya ba zhes pa'i ming dang*/ de'i steng du yaḥyig gshin rje gshed kyi ngo bos mnan par bsam/ re mig nang ma la phyogs bzhir hūṃ sha truṃ mā ra ya hūṃ zhes pa dang*/ mtshams bzhi la phaṭa sha druṃ mā ra ya phaṭa/ ces pa dang*/ re mig re re'i mtha' skor du hrīḥṣ+tiḥs bskor ba/ re mig phyi ma'i phyogs dang mtshams kyi sngags spyi gong dang 'dra ba las/ re mig re re'i mdun nas rim pa bzhin du/ ya ma rā dza zhes pa dang*/ de bzhin du sa do me ya dang*/ ya me do ru dang*/ ṇa yo da ya dang*/ ya da yo ni dang*/ ra ya k+ṣe ya dang*/ yak+ṣe yats+tsha dang*/ ni ra ma ya dang/ zhes pa'i yi ge bzhi bzhis bskor bar bsam la/ rlung cung zad bzung la/ lte ba'i me rlung gi steng na gnas pa'i raṃ gnyis kyi bar gyi dgra bgegs kyi ming dang*/ de'i steng gi yaḥyig la sems gtso bor gtad cing*/ oṃ ya mān+ta ka sha truṃ mā ra ya hūṃ phaṭa/ ces pa khri phrag gcig tsam bzlas la/ de bzhin du oṃ hrīḥṣ+tiḥbi kri tā na na sha truṃ mā ra ya hūṃ phaṭa/ ces pa phyogs mtshams kyi re mig brgyad po rnams la rim pa bzhin du bzlas la/ rgyas par na thams cad la khri phrag re re dang*/ bsdu na thams cad sdom pa la khri phrag gcig go /de bzhin du phyi'i re mig la dmigs la phyogs bzhi la/ oṃ ya ma rā dza sha truṃ mā ra ya hūṃ/ zhes pa lta bu mthar hūṃ yod pa dang*/ mtshams bzhi la/ oṃ sa do me ya sha truṃ mā ra ya phaṭa/ ces pa lta bu phaṭa tha mar yod pa bya'o/ /grangs ni rgyas par na khri phrag re re dang*/ bsdu na thams cad sdom pa la khri phrag gcig bzla zhing*/ bzlas pa'i dngos gzhi'i dmigs pa/ yig 'bru las 'od zer 'phro ba la sems gtad cing*/ thun gyi mjug tu drag po'i dmigs pa ni/ 'khor lo'i lte ba na gnas pa'i gnod byed kyi ming de nyid dgra bgegs kyi gzugs su gyur par bsam zhing*/ yig 'bru rnams las pho nya drag gtum sna tshogs pa mtshon cha thogs pas dgra bgegs kyi lus dum bur gtub pa dang/

mes bsregs pa dang*/ dug dang nad kyi char phab ste lus rul zhing myags par byed pa sogs sngags brgya tsam gyi ring*/ thun gyi tha mar dmigs pa de lta bu bya'o/ /de ltar 'khor lo gnyis po'i bsnyen pa legs par song nas/ drag po'i dmigs pa'i bsnyen pa zhag bdun la sogs pa ci rigs pa bya ba las/ de yang rang nyid rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi rnam par gsal ba'i thugs ka'i rgyu'i 'jam dpal rdo rje'i 'jigs byed kyi sku'i rnam par gyur pa la/ yid kyis mchod pa/ bstod pa/ gtor ma 'bul ba rnams byas la/ drag po'i las 'grub par mdzad du gsol/ ces gsol ba btab pas 'jigs byed/ kyi thugs ka nas hūṃ sngon po zhig spros/ lte ba'i 'khor lo la thim pas/ rlung dang me'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du rdo rje sa gzhi'i steng du gong gi 'khor lo gnyis po gang 'god zhig gsal btab/ thugs ka'i 'jigs byed kyi sku las hūṃ yig sngon po dang*/ pho nya'i tshogs dpag tu med pa spros/ lte ba'i 'khor lo'i nang gi yig 'bru'am/ yang na yig 'bru rnams lhar gyur pa la thim/ dgra bgegs thams cad tshar gcod cig /ces bka' bsgos pas yig 'bru'am lha sku rnams las 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i pho nya'i tshogs dpag tu med pa spros/ dmigs gsal can gyi dgra bgegs yod na de dang*/ med na phyogs bcu'i gdug pa can gyi dgra bgegs thams cad me rlung gi steng du/ lcags kyu zhags pas sbyor bas bkug ste/ 'khor lo'i lte ba'i yaḥyig gi dbus kyi dgra bgegs ming*/ dgra bgegs kyi gzugs su gyur pa la thim par bsam zhing*/ oṃ ya mān+ta ka sha druṃ a kar+ṣa ya dzaḥdzaḥ zhes pa dang*/ de bzhin du snying po dang*/ rtsa sngags la yang sbyar ba bzla zhing mthar/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ zhes brjod do/ /de nas yig 'bru rnams las 'jig rten las 'das pa'i khro bo dpag tu med pa spros/ de dag gis dgra bgegs kyi lus mtshon cha sna tshogs pas dum bur gtubs shing*/

sha khrag rnams zhal du gsol bar bsam/ yang dgra bgegs kyi lus sngar bzhin grub pa la yig 'bru'am lha sku rnams las gshin rje dang*/ srin po dang*/ mkha' 'gro ma dang*/ ma mo la sogs pa 'jig rten pa'i lha tshogs spros te/ de dag gi mtshon cha sna tshogs pas lus dum bur gtubs shing sha khrag zhal du gsol bar bsam/ yang dgra bgegs kyi lus sngar bzhin grub pa la/ bya dang gcan zan dang*/ sbrul gdug pa can dpag tu med pa spros te/ dgra bgegs kyi sha rus rnams zos par bsam/ yang sngar bzhin grub pa la/ dug gi char phab ste lus thams cad rul zhing myags par bsam/ yang lus sngar bzhin grub pa la/ nad kyi char ba khrag gi rnam pa can dpag tu med pa babs te tshar bcad par bsam/ yang lus sngar bzhin grub pa la/ mes bsregs shing mthar thal ba rnams kyang rlung gis khyer bar bsam mo/ /de dag gi ring la/ oṃ hrīḥṣ+tiḥbi kritā na na gnod byed dgra bgegs thams cad mā ra ya hūṃ phaṭa/ ces pa dang*/ de bzhin du ya mān+ta ka dang*/ ya ma rā dza la yang btags la bzla'o/ /de dag gi skabs su yang bum pa can gyi sbyor bas 'gog bzlas bya zhing*/ ci ste mi nus na yid kyis bzlas pa bya'o/ /de ltar na nang gi 'khor lo'i bsnyen pa sngon du legs par song na phyi'i 'khor lo la brten pa'i las tshogs rnams thogs med du 'grub par gyur ro/ /zhal gdams nyer drug pa'o/ /༈ sa bcad gnyis pa mchog gi bsnyen pa rdzogs rim gyi gdams pa la/ mtshan mo rgyu ba'i rnal 'byor/ rwa bsgom pa'i zhal shes mtshan ma gyen bsgrengs te gsum las/ dang po ni/ lus gnad legs par bcas la/ zhal phyag lhag ma rnams rtsa ba'i zhal phyag la bsdus la/ rang nyid zhal gcig phyag gnyis par gsal ba'i ma he'i zhal gyi sna rtse la sems gtad cing*/ rlung dal bus phyir bus la/ sna rtser rlung gi reg bya la sems gtad/ tshul de lta bu thun bzhir bcad la zla phyed la sogs par bsgom la/

de nas rlung dal bus nang du rngub cing*/ sna rtser rlung gi reg bya la sems gtad/ de yang zla phyed tsam gyi bar du bsgom/ de nas rlung dal bus phyir bus shing*/ dal bus nang du rngub la sna rtser rlung gi reg bya la sems gtad do/ /de nas rang nyid kyi lus nang nas rlung rnams 'od zer sna lnga'i rnam pas rlung rnams phyir 'gro ba dang*/ mnyam du sna bug gnyis nas phyir song brtan g.yo snod bcud thams cad la phog pas/ thams cad gdos bcas kyi rnam pa spangs te 'od du yal yal 'dug par bsam la/ bden med yin/ sgyu ma lta bu yin snyam pa'i dran 'dun drag tu bya/ de nas rlung 'od zer gyi rnam pa can rnams nang du dal bus rngub pa dang mnyam du/ sna bug gnyis nas zhugs te lus nang thams cad gang bas/ rang nyid rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi rnam par gsal ba de nyid dwangs gsal 'od du yal yal bar 'dug par bsam la/ bden med yin/ sgyu ma lta bu yin snyam pa'i dran 'dun drag tu bya'o/ /de nas mtshan mo rgyu ba'i dmigs pa dngos gzhi ni/ mtshan mo yin na de dang*/ nyin mo yin na mun khung du 'dug la/ lus gnad legs par bcas/ mig gi lta stangs sna rtse la gtad/ sems rlung phyir 'gro nang 'gro la cung zad gtad cing*/ gzhan bzo bcos med par shig ge bzhag /de dag ni dmigs chen gcig las phye ba'i dmigs phran lnga'o/ /de yi bogs 'don yan lag tu 'di ltar bsgom par bya ba yin te/ rang dang snod bcud thams cad 'od du yul yul ba/ snang yang bden pa'i stong pa de la dmigs pa'i gzhi byas gnas la cung zad cig bzhag go /de nas sa rdo ri brag rtsi shing nags tshal la sogs pa gzugs can du snang ba'i rnam rtog ci shar ba thams cad med bzhin du 'khrul ba'i snang ba sgyu ma lta bur shes par byas la/ de nas dbyings su yal bar bsam zhing*/ bzo bcos med par bzhag /de ni gzugs phung gi rnam rtog dbyings su bkod pa ste/

zla phyed la sogs ci rigs par bsgom mo/ /de la 'byongs na dus gsum du snang ba'i bde sdug gi rnam rtog yid la shar ba rnams sgyu ma lta bur shes par byas la dbyings su yal bar bsam zhing*/ bzo bcos med par bzhag /de ni tshor phung dbyings su skyel ba ste/ sngar bzhin 'byongs 'byongs kyi bar du bsgom mo/ /de nas 'di dang 'di lta bu'o snyam du 'dzin pa'i ming don gyi 'du shes rnams sgyu ma lta bur shes par byas la dbyings su skyel zhing*/ bzo med du bzhag ste 'du shes kyi phung po dbyings su skyel ba ste/ de ma 'byongs kyi bar du bsgom mo/ /de nas 'dod chags zhe sdang la sogs pa mi dge ba'i las kyi rnam rtog dang*/ dad pa nges 'byung la sogs pa dge ba'i las kyi rnam rtog ste/ 'du byed kyi rnam rtog thams cad kyang sgyu ma lta bur shes par byas la dbyings su skyel zhing*/ bzo med du bzhag go /de ni 'du byed kyi phung po'i rnam rtog dbyings su skyel ba ste ma 'byongs kyi bar du bsgom mo/ /de nas mig gis gzugs dngos su mthong ba dang*/ de bzhin du rna bas sgra dang*/ snas dri dang*/ lces ro dang*/ lus kyis reg bya la sogs pa dngos su myong ba rnams kyang sgyu ma lta bur shes par byas la/ sngar bzhin dbyings su yal bar bsam la/ bzo med du bzhag/de ni rnam shes kyi phung po dbyings su skyel ba ste/ ma 'byongs kyi bar du bsgom mo/ /de nas 'gro 'chag nyal 'dug zas za ba gtam smra ba sogs spyod lam thams cad la yang sngar bzhin sgyu ma lta bur shes pa dang*/ dbyings su skyel zhing ma bcos par bzhag go /de ltar dmigs pa'i rnam grangs drug tu byed pa'i rgyu mtshan ni/ sbyin sreg gi rtog par sha drug gi sbyin sreg bya bar gsungs pa'i nges don bsgom pa'i tshul yin no/ /de dag ni mtshan mo rgyu ba'i zhal gyi gdams pa'o/ /de'i yan lag tu sbyor ba bcud len gyi dmigs pa la nang gi bcud len dang*/

phyi'i bcud len gnyis/ dang po ni/ rang nyid rdo rje 'jigs byed phyag gnyis par gsal ba'i smin mtshams su hūṃ nag po/ spyi gtsug tu haṃ dkar po mgo bo thur du bstan pa/ lce chung du sum dkar po mgo bo thur du bstan pa/ klu lhag ldan zhes bya ba sbrul gyi rnam pa zhig sgom pa yin pa las/ de'i mjug ma'i nang tsam du smin mtshams kyi hūṃ chud pa/ sbrul gyi bshang lam gyi thad du hūṃ dkar po mgo bo thur du bstan pa de gnas pa/ sbrul gyi mgo bo thur du bstan pa'i kha nang du suṃ dkar po mgo bo thur du bstan pa de tshud par bsam/ snying ga'i pad+ma 'dab brgyad kyi lte ba la lartu'i i mgo bo thur du bstan pa/ 'dab ma brgyad la phaṭa re rer yod pa/ thams cad kyang dkar ram me ba zhig dmigs la/ rlung phyir sna nas bus la nang du rngub pa'i tshe/ so bsregs nas sa'i sgra dang bcas te lce steng nas drangs la/ smin mtshams kyi hūṃ las bdud rtsi'i tshogs dpag tu med pa byung*/ sbrul gyi mjug ma'i nang nas zhugs te/ spyi bor sbrul gyi bshang lam gyi thad du slebs pa na haṃ las bdud rtsi'i rgyun byung sbrul gyi lus nang nas brgyud de kha nang gi suṃ la reg pas/ de las bdud rts-i tshogs dpag tu med pa byung*/ mgrin pa nas brgyud/ snying ga'i pad+ma 'dab brgyad kyi yi ge rnams la thim pas/ de dag las bdud rtsi'i tshogs mtha' yas pa byung ste/ lus kyi nang thams cad gang bar bsam la/ rlung bum pa can bzung ngo*/ /gnyis pa phyi'i bcud len ni/ rang nyid rdo rje 'jigs byed phyag mang du gsal ba'i thugs kar hūṃ las 'od zer gyi tshogs dpag tu med pa spros pas brtan g.yo snod bcud thams cad la phog cing*/ phyogs bcu'i dgra bgegs thams cad tshar bcad pa'i sha khrag nam mkha' gang ba rnams rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi khro zhal brgyad po rnams kyis gsol bar bsam zhing*/ snod bcud thams cad kyi bkrag mdangs rnams 'jam dpal gyi zhal nas drangs shing thugs kar slebs pa na de gnyis dbyer med du gyur te bdud rtsir zhu zhing mthar lus thams cad gang bar mos la bum pa can bzung ngo*/

/mtshan mo rgyu ba'i yan lag tu sbyor ba nang gi sbyin sreg ni/ rang nyid rdo rje 'jigs byed du gsal ba'i spyi bor bdud rtsi'i bum pa mgo thur du bstan pa/ zhabs khrol tshags su yod pa'i nang bdud rtsis gang ba/ snying gar rgyu'i 'jam dpal lam yang na rdo rje zhig bsgom/ lte ba'i rtsa bdud gru gsum gyi nang du chos 'byung rtsa ba lte 'og tu zug cing gdengs ka lte ba'i thad du sleb pa'i/ me thab kyi rnam pa can du gsal btab/ de'i nang du 'khor lo gnyis po gang rung zhig yig 'bru dang bcas pa gsal 'debs pa las/ gshin rje gshed spyi'i 'khor lo gtso che bar mdzad do/ /de nas rlung ro bsal la/ gsang gnas kyi rlung 'then/ de nas bshang sgo'i rlung yang 'then zhing lte bar slebs pa na/ chos 'byung gi nang thams cad du me lce 'bar te snying gar slaibs pa na/ yi dam gyi me ri'am 'od zer dang 'dres te/ 'bar ba'i me nang du bzhugs par bsam zhing*/ snying ga'i yi dam gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas brtan g.yo thams cad kyi bkrag dang mdangs rnams bdud rtsi'i rnam par bkug nas rang gi spyi bo nas zhugs/ bum pa'i zhabs nas zhugs te bum pa'i nang gi bdud rtsi dang 'dres te/ bdud rtsi'i tshogs dpag tu med pa babs te/ snying gar me lce 'bar ba'i steng du babs pas tshim par bsam la/ rngub chung byas la steng rlung drag tu mnan/ 'og rlung rang sar glod cing*/ yi dam gyi sngags gsum po gang rung gi mthar/ oṃ ag+ne ye hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ zhes pa bzla'o/ /las bzhi so so'i lde kha bsgyur na gzhan gong dang 'dra ba las/ zhi ba la me sngags kyi mthar shan+tiṃ ku ru swāhā/ zhes dang*/ me lce dkar po 'bar bar bsam/ de bzhin du dbang la ba shaṃ ku ru hoḥ zhes pa dang*/ me lce dmar po/ rgyas pa la tshe dang bsod nams puṣ+taṃ ku ru oṃ zhes pa dang*/ me lce ser po/ drag po la dgra bgegs thams cad mā ra ya phaṭa/

ces pa dang*/ me lce dmar nag 'bar bar bsam mo/ /drag po'i las kyi dmigs pa ni/ rang nyid rdo rje 'jigs byed zhal phyag yongs rdzogs su gsal ba'i spyi bo'i bum pa mi bsgoms pa ma gtogs gzhan sngar dang 'dra ba las/ snying ga'i yi dam gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i dgra bgegs bkug la zhal dgu po rnams kyis sha chom rus chom du gsol ba rnams snying gar me lce 'bar ba'i steng du cil cil zhu bar bsam mo/ /'di ni nang gi drag po'i sbyin sreg go / de nas yang gzhan sngar dang 'dra ba las/ snying ga'i yi dam gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ brtan g.yo thams cad kyi bkrag mdangs rnams bdud rtsi'i rnam par bkug pa rnams rang gi sgo dgu nas zhugs/ snying gar me lce 'bar ba'i steng du babs shing zhu bar bsam mo/ /'di ni rlung sems dbu mar thim pa dang/ rlung dul bar gyur pa'i thabs so/ /de dag ni mtshan mo rgyu ba'i man ngag dang rjes su 'brel ba'i man ngag zhal gyi gdams pa'o/ /gnyis pa rwa sgom pa'i zhal shes sam/ zhal dgu po'i rdzogs rim la sngon 'gro dang*/ dngos gzhi gnyis las/ dang po ni/ lus gnad bcas la nyin gcig rlung phyir 'bud pa 'ba' zhig byas shing*/ de yang thun bzhir bcad de grangs lnga brgya la sogs pa bya/ yang nyin gcig lus gnad bcas la rlung rang babs su bzhag tshul de lta bu zla gcig la sogs pa bsgoms na/ lus ldang ba yang ba dang*/ nad byang la sogs pa 'byung ngo*/ /de nas 'jam rlung bzung la mgo bo la sogs pa lus kyi gnad thams cad khu tshur gyis brdeg pa dang*/ shugs dang ldan pas lus thams cad la 'phur mnye byed pa dang*/ mgo dang rkang lag la sogs pa sprugs pa dang*/ yan lag rnams brkyang bskum byed pa sogs dang*/ 'jam rlung bzung ste gyen la rgyug pa dang*/ thur la rgyug pa dang*/ 'khrab pa dang*/ ngag nas ha 'don zhing 'khrab pa sogs bya'o/ /de ltar byas pas 'khru skyug dang nad gzhi ldang ba sogs byung na/

phyis gegs mi 'byung bas legs shing*/ skabs 'dir gzhan nas 'byung ba ltar gyi lus sbyong sbyar na yang legs gsung ngo*/ /dngos gzhi ni/ rang nyid rde rje 'jigs byed zhal phyag yongs su rdzogs pa'am/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis par ji ltar bde bar gsal ba'i lte 'og sor bzhi'am sor brgyad tsam du ma he'i zhal rwa dang bcas pa/ dbu skra dang*/ mgrin pa sogs me 'bar ba'i bsgribs pa/ dper na me dpung gi dbus nas ma he'i zhal 'thon pa lta bu zhig bsgom/ 'di la dmigs pa gsal na mdun rgyab g.yas g.yon mtshams bzhi sogs gang nas bltas kyang ma he'i zhal yod pa'i kun tu zhal du bsgom/ de lta bu las dang po pa la mi gsal na/ mdun du bstan pa'i ma he'i zhal gcig ka bsgom/ lus kyi dbus su rtsa dbu ma kha dog sngon po yas sna rang gi spyi bo dang*/ mas sna lte 'og ma he'i zhal gyi spyi bo brgyud de rkan gyi sbubs su zug pa/ g.yas phyogs kyi rwa la dum bu gsum du byas pa'i sum gcig yar song*/ gsum gnyis mar lus pa tsam gyi mtshams su thog mar thig le ser po zhig rwa nang du yod pa de phyir brdol de/ rwa'i phyi ngos la khro zhal ser po ltag pa'i cha la brten pa/ shing sdong gi sbal lta bu zhig gsal btab/ rang gi g.yas phyogs su ro ma ser po yas sna spyi bo dang*/ mas sna khro zhal ser po'i zhal la zug par bsam/ lus gnad rkang ba skyil krung*/ lag pa khu tshur brla bzhag bya/ rlung sbyor ni/ rlung ro bsal la/ rlung nang du hūṃ gi sgras dal bus rngub la kha sbyor du bzung*/ de nas phyir drag tu bus la/ nang du drag tu rngub la grug zhud kyi rlung sbyor cung zad bya zhing*/ de nas phyir dal bus btang ngo*/ /de dag gi skabs su dmigs pa ni rang nyid kyi lus nang nas rlung thamasacad kha dog ser po'i rnam pas byung*/ ro ma'i nang nas brgyud nas mar song khro zhal gyi zhal nas zhugs/ rwa'i nang nas mar song*/

ma he'i zhal gyi rkan gyi sbubs kyi dbu ma'i mas sna nas zhugs te/ sor bzhi tsam song ba na yal bar bsam mo/ /de ni sa rlung 'dzin pa'i thabs so/ /thun gyi mthar khro zhal ser po de nyid thig le ser por gyur te rwa'i nang du zhugs/ mthar yal bar bsam mo/ /chu rlung 'dzin pa'i thabs ni/ lus gnad pad+ma'i skyil krung dang*/ lag pa gnyis brkyangs te pus mo'i steng du bzhag ste zla gam gyi tshul du bya/ dmigs pa ni lte 'og gi ma he'i zhal gyi g.yon gyi rwa yi rtsa ba'i nang du thig le dkar po de yongs su gyur pa las/ rwa'i phyi rol kyi rtsa bar g.yon zhal dang po dkar po rmongs par byed pa gsal btab pa'i lus kyi g.yon phyogs su rkyang ma dkar po yas sna spyi bo dang*/ mas sna lte ba'i ma he'i g.yon phyogs kyi zhal dkar po'i nang du tshud par bsgom/ rlung ro bsal la/ rlung nang du sgra dang bcas te rngub/ rngub pa rdzogs mtshams su kha nang gi rlung yang sgra bcas su rngub ste bum pa can gyi rlung sbyor bya/ dmigs pa ni lus kyi nang nas rlung thams cad 'od zer dkar po'i rnam pas byung*/ rkyang ma'i nang nas shong tshad du song rwa'i rtsa'i zhal gyi nang nas zhugs/ ma he'i zhal gyi rkan gyi sbubs kyi dbu ma'i mas sna nas zhugs/ sor bzhi tsam nas yal bar bsam/ rkyang ma'i nang nas zhugs pa ma yin pa'i rlung thams cad kyang khro zhal dkar po'i zhal gyi grwa zur nas zhugs par mos so/ /'di'i dmigs rten snod gang rung zhig chus gang ba la mig gtad/ thun 'jog khar khro zhal dkar po thig le dkar po zhig tu gyur te/ rwa'i nang du zhugs par bsam zhing mthar thig ler thim mo/ /me rlung 'dzin pa'i thabs ni/ lus gnad sems dpa'i skyil krung dang*/ lag pa gnyis khu tshur mkhal khung gnyis la brten pa'i lag pa gru mo cung zad brkyangs te/ me'i dkyil 'khor gru gsum gyi tshul du bya/ dmigs pa lte 'og gi ma he'i zhal dang*/

dbu ma sogs sngar dang 'dra ba las/ g.yas phyogs kyi rwa'i rked pa tsam gyi nang du thog mar thig le dmar po/ de yongs su gyur pa las rwa'i phyi rol du khro zhal dmar po/ ro ma dmar po zhal du chud par bsam/ rlung sbyor ni/ rlung ro bsal la/ nang du rngub la kha sbyor du cung zad zhig bzung la/ de nas gsang gnas kyi rlung dang*/ bshang sgo'i rlung drag tu 'then zhing rlung kha sbyor stod du drangs shing rked pa nyag tsam bya/ de nas rlung lte bar phab la sangs kyis btang ngo*/ /dmigs pa ni lus nang nas rlung thams cad kha dog dmar po'i rnam pas stod smad thams cad nas byung*/ ro ma'i nang nas zhugs te/ khro zhal dmar po'i zhal gyi nang nas zhugs/ ro ma'i nang du ma zhugs pa'i rlung thams cad khro zhal dmar po'i zhal gyi grwa zur nas zhugs te/ thams cad kyang rwa'i nang du brgyud de ma he'i rkan sbubs kyi dbu ma'i mas sna nas zhugs/ sor bzhi tsam du yal bar bsam/ 'di'i dmigs rten mar me lta bu zhig la mig gtad/ thun 'jog khar khro zhal dmar po de nyid thig le dmar po zhig tu gyur te rwa'i nang du mi dmigs par bsam mo/ rlung gi rlung 'dzin pa ni/ lus gnad zlum po'i 'dug stangs su byed par bshad kyang*/ da lta lag len la rkang pa rdo rje skyil krung 'chug par bya zhing lag gnyis khu tshur byas la 'phong tshos g.yas g.yon gyi thad kyi gdan steng du bzhag /rlung sbyor ni/ rlung dal bus phyir bsam zhing*/ nang du yang shugs chung ngus dal bus rngub la nang du kha sbyor du bzung la/ gsus pa smad phyir phul la ldir bar bya/ rlung gtong ba'i tshe lto ba ma zhum par byas la sangs kyis gtong*/ dmigs pa ni/ lte ba'i ma he'i rwa g.yon phyogs kyi rtse mo'i cha la thog mar nang du thig le nag po/ de phyir thon nas yongs su gyur pa las khro zhal nag po/ de'i zhal du rkyang ma kha dog nag po'i mas sna zur ba/ gzhan sngar dang 'dra ba zhig bsgom la/

rlung sbyor gyi skabs su lus kyi nang nas rlung rnams kha dog nag po'i rnam pas stod smad thams cad nas byung*/ rkyang ma'i nang nas zhugs/ khro zhal nag po'i zhal du zhugs shing*/ rkyang ma'i nang du ma chud pa'i rlung thams cad zhal gyi grwa zur nas zhugs shing thams cad kyang rwa'i lam brgyud/ ma he'i zhal gyi rkan spubs dbu ma'i mas sna nas zhugs te/ sor bzhi tsam du yal bar bsam zhing*/ 'di la dmigs rten dkar po khung nas rlung gi reg bya lus la phog par bya zhes bshad kyang*/ skabs 'gar de ltar bya zhing*/ rgyun du byas na rlung khams ldang bas de ltar mi bya gsung*/ rnam shes kyi rlung 'dzin pa ni/ lte 'og gi ma he'i zhal gyi g.yon phyogs kyi rwa'i dkyil gyi nang du thog mar thig le dud kha/ de phyir thon te yongs su gyur pa las khrau zhal dud kha zhig bsgom/ lus kyi g.yon phyogs su rkyang ma dud kha'i mas sna khrau zhal dud kha'i nang du zug pa/ gzhan sngar dang 'dra ba las lus gnad rkang pa sems skyil lam rdo rje skyil krung gang rung zhig byas la/ lag pa mnyam bzhag bya/ rlung sbyor ni/ rlung ro bsal/ nang du rngub la bum can bzung la/ mdun ngos su phyir phul/ rgyab ngos su phul la lto ba tshigs pa la gcer ba byas la btang ngo*/ /dmigs pa ni/ rlung dud kha'i rnam pas lus nang nas byung rkyang ma'i nang nas zhugs/ zhal dud kha'i nang nas zhugs/ rkyang ma'i nang du ma zhugs pa'i rlung thams cad kyang zhal gyi grwa zur nas zhugs te/ ma he'i rkan sbubs nas brgyud de dbu ma'i mas sna nas zhugs te/ sor bzhi tsam du yal bar bsam/ mthar zhal dud kha thig le dud khar gyur te/ rwa'i nang du zhugs la yal bar bsam mo/ /nam mkha'i rlung 'dzin pa ni/ g.yas phyogs kyi rwa'i rtsa bar khro zhal sngon po sgom pa dang*/ ro ma yang kha dog sngon por byed pa dang*/ rlung rnams kyang kha dog sngon por byed pa'i khyad par ma gtogs lus gnad rlung sbyor dmigs pa la sogs pa bshad ma thag pa dang 'dra'o/

/srin zhal dmar po bsgom pa'i tshul ni/ rang gi lte 'og gi ma he'i zhal gyi steng du srin zhal dmar po de'i spyi bo nas brgyud de/ ma he'i rkan sbubs su dbu ma'i mas sna zug par bsam la/ rlung sbyor dang lus gnad kyi khyad par ni/ rkang pa'i brang sa la btsugs shing rting ba gnyis gyen du bstan pa'i steng du 'phong bzhag pa'am/ de mi bde na rkang mthil sa la bzhag pas tsog pu'i 'dug stangs dang rlung ro bsal ba'i skabs su lag pa gnyis gyen du brkyangs shing*/ 'og rlung drag tu 'then zhing*/ 'phong yang cung zad bteg cing*/ rlung phyi rol tu cung zad bzung*/ nang du rngub pa dang mnyam du lag pa gnyis khu tshur bcings pa mchan khung g.yas g.yon gnyis su bcug cing*/ pus mo gnyis sa la btsugs shing 'phong yang rting ba'i steng du bzhagarlung kha sbyor du bzung zhing de nas rlung kha sbyor de nyid stod du 'then zhing*/ mgo dang ro stod g.yas su lan gsum bskor ba dang*/ g.yon du lan gsum bskor bar bya/ rlung phyir 'bud pa'i tshe lag pa gnyis gyen du brkyang ba sogs sngar bzhin bya'o/ /dmigs pa ni/ lus kyi smad kyi cha nas thur sel gyi rlung gtso bor gyur pa'i rlung rnams kha dog sna tshogs pa'i rnam pas byung ste/ srin zhal gyi zhal nas zhugs/ ma he'i dbu ma'i nang nas brgyud/ rkan sbubs kyi dbu ma'i mas sna nas zhugs te sor bzhi tsam nas yal bar bsam mo/ /'di ni thur sel gyi rlung stod du 'dren pa'i thabs so/ /srog gi rlung smad du 'dren pa'i thabs ni/ lus gnad sems dpa'i skyil krung la lag pa g.yas g.yon gnyis kyis rkang ba'i bol gong gi stod tsam la 'ju ba'am/ yang na de dang de'i thad kyi gdan steng du btsugs la/ ro stod sgur ba dang*/ dgye ba re mos su bshad kyang*/ rlung phyir 'bud pa'i tshe sgur ba dang*/ gzhan ro stod sogs lus skyed par bya zhing*/ rlung sbyor ni/

rlung ro bsal ba'i tshe thur sel gyi rlung yang drag tu 'then nas/ kha sna gnyis kar nas rngub la nang du 'dzin pa'i tshe/ 'og rlung rang gnas su bzhag cing*/ steng rlung gsang gnas kyi bu ga'i phyogs su drag tu gnon pa dang*/ bshang sgo'i phyogs su 'phul ba re mos su bya/ de nas rlung phyir 'bud pa'i tshe/ thur sel 'then zhing rngub pa'i tshe kha sna gnyis kar nas dus gcig tu rngub pa sogs sngar bzhin bya'o/ /dmigs pa ni/ lte 'og gi ma he'i zhal sogs dgu char yod pa la lam tsam dmigs la/ gtso bor srin zhal gyi steng du 'jam dpal gyi zhal ser po bsgom la/ lus kyi stod kyi cha mgo bo dang lag pa'i sor mo tshun chad kyi nang nas rlung kha dog sna tshogs pa dpag tu med pa byung ba rnams 'jam dpal gyi zhal nas zhugs/ srin zhal dang ma he'i dbu gtsug nas brgyud de/ ma he'i zhal gyi nang tsam du yal bar bsam mo/ /srog dang thur sel mnyam par byed pa'i thabs ni/ rtsa zhal la brten nas sgom pa ste lus gnad ni rkang pa ya gcig gis bshang sgo bkag cing*/ ya gcig gis gsang gnas mnan/ lag pa khu tshur brla'i steng du bzhag cing*/ mig steng du blta'o/ /rlung sbyor ni/ kha sna gnyis kar nas rlung bus shing*/ nang du sna nas rngub la kha sbyaur du bzung zhing*/ lto ba tshigs pa la gcer/ mig gyen du bsgrad la/ rkang lag gis sor mo bskums shing lus kyi nywa bzhi bsgrim mo/ / dmigs pa ni/ lte 'og gi ma he'i zhal gyi nang tsam du/ raṃ maṃ k+ṣa dmar po zhig gsal 'debs pa las raṃ sgom pa gtso che/ rang gi snying ga'i thad kyi dbu ma'i nang du hūṃ sngon po 'od zer 'phro ba zhig bsgom/ spyi bo'i thad kyi dbu ma'i nang du haṃ dkar po mgo thur du bstan pa zhig dmigs la/ raṃ las me 'bar dbu ma'i nang du brgyud de/ spyi bo'i haṃ la reg pas haṃ las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pa/ snying ga'i hūṃ la babs pas tshim zhing rgyas par bsam la gtum mo'i me rang gnas su log

/yang gtum mo'i me 'bar ba sogs sngar bzhin bsgom mo/ /'di la sbyor ba drug dang ldan pa ste dbang po'i mchog gyen du bgrad pa dang*/ ro 'dzin rkan la sbyar ba dang*/ rgya mtsho ri rab la gcer ba dang*/ gling bzhi dbang du bsdu ba dang*/ rlung phyir 'bud pa'i tshe kha sna gnyis car nas bum pa'i stobs kyis ha'i sgra 'byung ba'i ngag gi 'gyur ba dang*/ lus nywa bzhi bsgrims pa dang drug /rkang pa g.yas g.yon gnyis kyi rting pas bshang sgo 'gag pa dang*/ gsang gnas gnod pa gnyis res mos su bya/ de dag ni rwa sgom pa'i zhal shes sam zhal dgu'i rdzogs rim mo/ /༈ gsum pa mtshan ma gyen bsgreng la/ sngon 'gro dang*/ dngos gzhi dang*/ rjes gsum las/ dang po ni/ rang nyid rdo rje 'jigs byed du gsal ba'i lus kyi dbus su rtsa dbu ma chos bzhi dang ldan pa yas sna spyi gtsug tu zug cing mas sna gsang gnas su zug pa'i spyi bor haṃ dkar po/ rdo rje nor bur thig le yungs 'bru tsam mam sran ma tsam kha dog dkar po zhig bsgom la/ lus gnad legs par bcas la/ hūṃ gi sgras rlung phyir 'bud pa'i tshe rdo rje nor bu'i thig le dbu ma'i nang nas yar hril gyis song ste/ spyi bo'i haṃ la thim par bsam/ haṃ de nyid 'dar khril khril 'dug pa la sems gtad la/ rlung phyir thub tshad du bzung*/ nang du rngub pa'i tshe spyi bo'i haṃ las thig le skya hril gyis byung ste/ dbu ma'i nang nas mar song ste rdo rje nor bur lhan gyis sleb par bsam la de la sems gtad cing rlung cung zad bzung ngo*/ /de'i go zlog ni/ rang gi spyi bor dbu ma'i nang du thig le dmar po/ rdo rje nor bu'i rtse mor a dmar por bsgom la/ rlung ro bsal/ rlung nang du rngub pa'i tshe hrīḥsgra yid la dran par byas te rngub la/ rngub pa rdzogs mtshams su ṣ+tiḥzhes pa'i sgra yid la dran par byed cing*/ de'i skabs su dmigs pa ni/

spyi bo'i thig le dmar hril gyis dbu ma'i nang nas mar song ste/ nor bu'i a la thim gyis thim par bsam zhing*/ a 'dar khril khril 'dug pa la sems gtad cing*/ rlung kha sbyor thub tshad du bzung*/ rlung phyir 'bud pa'i tshe nor bu nas thig le dmar hril gyis byung*/ dbu ma'i nang nas yar song*/ spyi bor sleb par bsam mo/ /de nas rang nyid 'jigs byed du gsal ba'i lus kyi dbus su rtsa dbu ma/ snying ga dang lte bar hūṃ re re bsgom/ de nas rlung phyir kha na ha'i sgras bus la/ nang du rngub pa'i tshe sna nas rngub cing*/ ha'i sgra yid la dran par bya/ de nas rlung kha sbyor du bzung la de nyid pho bar drangs shing*/ pho stod kyi cha ldir bar bya zhing*/ snying ga'i hūṃ la sems gtad/ yang kha sbyor de nyid rgyu zhabs su mnan zhing phyir bskyed la ldir ba bya zhing lte ba'i hūṃ la sems gtad do/ /༈ gnyis pa dngos gzhi la/ dngos dang/ bogs 'don gnyis las/ dang po ni/ lus gnad spyi dang mthun par bcas la/ lta stangs smin mtshams kyi thad kyi nam mkha' la blta/ rlung sbyor ni/ rlung ro bsal la rlung phyi rol tu thub tshad du bzung zhing*/ ma ning gi rlung gi ming can khog nang gi rlung shugs yang kha sbyor du bzung*/ rlung bus la phyi rol tu gzhil ba yang bya'o/ /gnyis pa bogs 'don la/ rlung sbyor gsum las/ dang po ni/ lus bskyed cing lag pa gnyis khu tshur bcings te bsnol ba rgyab tu sa la btsugs/ rlung sangs kyis bus la phyir thub tshad du bzung*/ nang gi rlung gi shugs kha sbyor du bzung ba de nyid stod du 'then 'then bya zhing phyir bus la gzhil ba yang bya'o/ /rlung sbyor gnyis pa ni/ lus cung zad sgur ba'i lag pa khu tshur/ bcings pa mdun du sa la bzhagarlung ro bsal la phyi rol tu thub tshad du bzung*/ de nas nang du rngub la rlung kha sbyor du bzung zhing sked pa nyag bya/ mi thub pa na kha nas gtong ngo*/

/rlung sbyor gsum pa ni/ lus gnad lag pa khu tshur brla bzhag gam/ brla'i rtsa ba'i gdan steng du bzhag la rlung ro bsal/ phyir thub tshad du bzung*/ nang du khog nang gi gsang gnas kyi rlung gi shugs dang*/ bshang sgo'i rlung gi shugs gnyis dus gcig tu 'then/ dus gcig tu 'then mi thub na res mos kyis 'then/ de nas rlung nang du rngub la kha sbyor du bzung*/ de nyid mdun gsang gnas phyogs su gnod pa dang*/ rgyab bshang sgo'i phyogs su gnon pa res mos bya zhing*/ de nas rlung gtong*/ dngos gzhi dang*/ bogs 'don gyi skabs kyi dmigs pa ni/ mi rtog par 'jog pa kho na nyid yin zhing*/ de ltar thabs de rnams la brten nas bsgoms pas rlung nang du rngub rgyu med par phyi rol tu yal ba lta bur gyur na cung zad 'byongs pa yin zhing*/ de nas yon tan rnams rim gyis skye'o/ /de yang yun ring du dngos gzhi'i rlung sbyor de nyid goms par byas la/ de'i rjes su bogs 'don gyi rlung sbyor dang po lta bu zhig thun gyi rjes su bcu gcig gam nyer gcig la sogs par bsgom pa zhag bdun la sogs par bya'o/ /de bzhin du rlung sbyor gnyis pa dang*/ gsum pa la sogs pa yang de mtshungs bya zhing*/ mthar gsum char thun gyi rjes su grangs ji ltar rigs pa bsgom pa zhag bdun la sogs par bya'o/ /bogs 'don gyi dmigs pa 'di rnams skabs su bya ba yin gyis dus rgyun du dngos gzhi'i rlung sbyor nyid sgom mo/ /gsum pa rjes la/ 'dren dang 'grem gnyis las/ dang po la/ thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa gnyis yod pa las/ dang po la thig le bzung ba ni/ mig steng du bsgrad/ lag pa'i sor mo shin tu bskum pa snying ga'i thad du bsnol ba'am/ yang na brang g.yas g.yon gnyis kyi thad du sbyar/ rkang pa'i sor mo rnams shin tu bskum par byas la/ lus nywa bzhi sgrim zhing lto ba tshigs pa la gcer/

thur sel gyi rlung bshang sgor drag tu glod do/ /thig le zlog pa ni/ dud 'gro'i 'gyur ba bzhi las/ glang chen hiṃ ni/ lus gnad sems skyil lam/ pus mo gnyis btsugs pa las/ lag pa gnyis mdun du btsugs la lus cung zad sgur bar bya/ sna nas hiṃ gi sgras rlung phyir bsal la/ lus cung zad sgur ba dang*/ de nas mgo dang ltag pa bskyed byas la/ lto ba tshigs pa la gcer bar bya'o/ / stag mo'i ngur ni/ lus gnad byed lugs spyi gong dang 'dra ba las/ rlung sna nas ngur sgra dang bcas 'bud pa'o/ /ce spyang hag ni/ gzhan sngar dang 'dra ba las/ rlung kha nas hag ces pa'i sgras 'bud pa'o/ /wa yi snom ni/ rlung sna nas bus la 'bud thag chod pa dang*/ slar yang nang du ma rngub par lan gsum la sogs pa 'bud do/ /gnyis pa thun mong ma yin pa la dngos dang*/ yan lag gnyis las/ dang po bzung ba ni/ lus gnad spyi dang mthun par bcas la rlung ro bsal/ 'og sgo glod nang du rngub cing*/ steng rlung bshang sgo'i gnas su drag tu mnan cing*/ de nas rlung gi shugs mdun phyogs su phul la/ gsus pa ldir gy-is bya zhing gsang gnas nas slar yang gyen du log ste/ rked pa'i thad tsam du sleb par bsam la rked pa nyag bya'o/ /de lta bu lan gsum bya'o/ /thun mong ma yin pa'i bzlog pa ni/ lus spyi g.yon phyogs su gcus te/ sog rtse 'phrod par bya/ mgo g.yas su gcus la rlung sna nas bus la stong 'dren bya/ de nas rlung nang du bzung la/ lus drang por bsrangs te/ lto ba g.yon du lan gsum bskor/ de rjes mgo dang ro stod yang lan gsum du bskor ro/ /de rjes rlung bus la stong 'dren bya'o/ /g.yas phyogs la yang de go zlog pa'o/ /de ni thun mong ma yin pa'i stong 'dren gyi rlung sbyor dngos so/ /gnyis pa yan lag la'ang gnyis las/ dang po ni lag gnyis bsnol ba rgyab tu btsugs/ rkang pa skyil krung bya/ de nas rlung sangs kyis bus la phyi rol tu bzung zhing*/

ltag pa skyed la stong 'dren bya/ de nas rngub la rlung kha sbyor du bzung la dgang 'dren bya'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ lag pa gnyis bsnol ba mdun du btsugs/ lus cung zad sgur la/ rlung ro bsal zhing*/ rlung phyi rol tu bzung la ltag pa sgur zhing stong 'dren bya/ yang nang du rngub cing kha sbyor du bzung la dgang 'dren bya'o/ /gnyis pa 'grims la thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa gnyis las/ thun mong ba ni/ seng ge rnam rol spyi dang mthun pa de yin zhing*/ thun mong ma yin pa la sdom ni/ lag pa zhags pa 'phang zhing dkrug sdeb bya/ zhes pa'i don ni/ rlung bzung zhing*/ lag pa g.yas mgo la bskor zhing*/ lan gsum zhags pa ltar 'phangs/ de bzhin du g.yon pa la yang bya/ lag pa gnyis dus gcig tu 'phangs shing*/ mgo dang lus sprug pa dang*/ 'phongs sa la bsdebs so/ /de bzhin du rlung phyir btang zhing ha sgra dang bcas la mgo lus sprug cing*/ 'phong sa la brdebs so/ /yang sdom ni/ khu tshur pus mor bzhag la gcus shing sprug ces pa/ lag pa gnyis khu tshur byas pa pus mo'i steng du bzhag /rlung bzung la ro stod g.yas su gcu ba dang*/ g.yon du gcu ba bya zhing*/ mgo lus thams cad sprug go /yang sdom ni/ khu tshur pus mo nas brtsams nu thad drangs// gru mo brgyangs la rtsibs log ngos la brdeg /ces pa'i don ni/ lag pa khu tshur pus mo nas brtsams nas nu ma'i thad du drangs/ gru mo brgyangs la rtsibs ma'i ngos la lan gsum brdeg go /

<'dir sdom ni/ ro stod sgur zhing lag gnyis chur btsal te/ g.yas g.yon dbus su drag tu brkyang ba dang*/ rlung phyir bzung la rdor bsdam spyi bor brdeg / nang du rngub la mnyam bzhag bya ba'o/ /ngag dbang tshogs gnyis rgya mtsho'i mchan yin/> lag pa gnyis shed bcug ste/ ro stod sgur zhing gyen ngos kyi g.yas phyogs su drag tu skyong ba dang*/ g.yon phyogs su yang skyong ba dang*/ dbus drang thad mgo'i thad du yang drag tu brkyangs shing*/ rlung phyir cung zad bzung la/ de nas lag pa'i sor mo rnams phan tshun bsnol ba'i lag mthil spyi gtsug la brdeg cing*/ rlung rngub la nang du bzung*/ lag pa mnyam bzhag bya'o/ /de nas rlung dang bsre ba ni/ rlung bum pa can 'dzin pa'o/ /dbyings su skyel ba ni/ dngos gzhi'i rlung sbyor ci rigs bsgom zhing*/ sems mi rtog par bzhag go /skabs 'dir gong gi hrīḥṣ+tiḥha zhes pa'i rlung kha sbyor yang sbyar ro/ /de dag gis ni mtshan mo rgyu ba'i zhal gdams rnams song nas/ de'i rjes su yan lag phra mo rnams ston pa las/ dang po rwa'i khrid ni/ rwa zhal mi byed na/ rwa thung ba la sor bcu drug pa dang*/ ring pa la nyi shu'o/ /rwa zhal byed na thung ba sor nyi shu dang*/ ring pa nyi shu rtsa bzhi'o/ /de la thog mar sor nyi shu'i dbang du byas te/ rang nyid 'jigs byed chen por gsal ba'i rwa shin tu rno ba/ sor nyi shu'i tshad du yod pa'i g.yas phyogs kyi rwa'i nang du rtse mo nas brtsams te/ oṃ ya ma rā dza sa do me ya ya me do ru ṇa yo da ya hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ ces pa'i yi ge nyi shu pa kha dog sngon por yod pa la dmigs la sngags de nyid bzla'o/ /g.yon phyogs kyi rwa'i nang du rtse mo nas brtsams la/ oṃ ya da yo ni ra ya k+ṣe ya ya k+ṣe yats+tsha ni ra ma ya hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ ces pa kha dog sngon por yod pa la dmigs la sngags de nyid bzla'o/ /sngags tshan gnyis po rwa g.yas g.yon gnyis la thun re mos bya zhing*/

tshul de lta bus khri phrag gcig gis bsnyen pa bya'o/ /grangs bsnyen song nas/ tshe sgrub kyi dmigs pa ni/ rwa nang gi sngags rnams kha dog dkar po bsgom zhing snying gar nyi ma la hūṃ sngon po dmigs la/ rwa g.yas g.yon gyi nang gi sngags rnams las bdud rtsi dkar po dpag tu med pa byung rwa'i nang khengs pas/ rwa sngo sangs du song ste/ rwa'i phyi rol tu me lce lhabs te 'bar/ rwa nang gi bdud rtsi rnams rim gyis zhal gyi rkan sbubs su sleb par bsam/ phyag g.yon gyi thod pa'i nang gi bdud rtsi ya k+ṣe ma me da zhes pa'am/ bh+ruṃ aṃ dz+raṃ khaṃ hūṃ zhes pa yongs su gyur pa las bdud rtsi dpag tu med par gyur/ brtan g.yo snod bcud thams cad kyi bkrag mdangs ye shes mi shigs pa thams cad bkug ste/ de la thim pa rtsa zhal gyis drangs te/ zhal du sleb pa rwa nang nas byung ba'i bdud rtsi rnams dang 'dres te/ thugs ka'i hūṃ la thim pas/ bkrag mdangs dang gzi brjid rgyas par bsam la/ rlung bum can bzung zhing*/ yid kyis hrīḥṣ+tiḥyi mthar/ ya mān+ta ka oṃ bh+rūṃ badz+ra ā yu she dzaḥhūṃ aḥzhes 'gog bzlas kyi tshul gyis bzla/ de lta bu mi thub na thog mar rlung ci rigs bzung la/ de nas ngag bzlas bya'o/ /rwa ring ba'i sgom tshul ni/ sor nyi shu rtsa bzhi yod pa'i rtse mor thig le/ oṃ ya mān+ta ka ya ma rā dza sa do me ya ya me do ru ṇa yo da ya hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ ces pa dang*/ g.yon phyogs su yang rtse mor thig le/ de nas/ oṃ ya mān+ta ka ya da yo ni ra ya k+ṣe ya ya k+ṣe yats+tsha ni ra ma ya hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ ces pa bkod la gzhan sngar dang 'dra'o/ /rwa thung bar bsgom na sor bcu drug yod pa'i g.yas phyogs la ya ma rā dza'i yi ge bcu drug dang*/ g.yon phyogs la yang*/ ya da yo ni la sogs pa'i yi ge bcu drug dang*/ gzhan thams cad gong dang 'dra'o/ /rwa dang ling ga'i dag pa sbyor tshul ni/ rwa sor bcu drug gi'i phyogs la/

g.yas la bcu drug dang*/ g.yon la bcu drug ste/ sum cu so gnyis ni/ phyi rol tu dkar phyogs nag phyogs zla ba'i 'phel 'grib byed pa dang*/ nang du khams kyi 'pho ba dang sbyor ba dang*/ rwa ring ba'i phyogs la g.yas la nyer bzhi dang*/ g.yon la nyer bzhi ste/ bzhi bcu zhe brgyad de'i steng du ling ga sor bcu gnyis bsnan pas drug cu ni/ chu tshod drug cu rnam par dag pa dang*/ 'bring po rwa nyi shu yang bcu drug gi steng du slar bzhi bzhi bsnan pa yin pas dga' ba bcu drug gi dag par sbyor zhing*/ ling ga sor bcu gnyis ni rlung 'pho ba bcu gnyis kyi dag par sbyor ro/ /de nas ling ga sgrub pa ni/ rang nyid 'jigs byed du gsal ba'i ling ga gyen du bsgreng ba/ gsang gnas nas bshang sgo'i thad du rtse sor bzhi'am sor gsum tsam gyen du gzhal ba'i rgyab ngos la cung zad nye ba'i dbus su gsang gnas kyi rtsib brgyad pa/ kha dog dkar po lte ba dbu ma'i mas snas phug pa/ 'dab ma brgyad la ya ma rā dza'i sngags kyis bskor ba/ ling ga skye mtshams su nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor de'i lte ba la yang rtsas phug pa/ mtha' bskor du hrīḥṣ+tiḥkha dog dmar pos bskor ba/ rdo rje'i mgul bar rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa phyed pa/ de'i lte ba dang dbus kyi rwa yang rtsas phug pa/ lte ba'i mtha' bskor du pha dang ṭa gnyis so sor phral ba'i ya mān+ta ka sngon pos bskor ba/ rdo rje nor bur thig le dmar po nyi dkyil lta bu de'i steng du/ a kar+ṣa ya hūṃ phaṭa/ ces pa kha dog dmar pos bskor/ 'bras bu gnyis la som re re bsgom/ thog mar bsnyen pa bya ste/ 'khor lo bzhi po de rnams la dmigs pa gtad la sngags rnams khri phrag re bzla'o/ / de nas grangs bsnyen song nas 'di ltar bsgom par bya ste/ 'bras bu som las reg bya shin tu tsha ba'i 'od zer kha dog sna tshogs pa 'phros dbu ma'i sbubs nas brgyud de gsang gnas kyi 'khor lor slebs pas/

lus kyi gnas thams cad nas 'od zer dkar po'i tshogs dpag tu med pa byung*/ gsang nas kyi 'khor lo la thim pas drag tu 'khor zhing 'od zer dkar po 'phro ba la/ 'bras bu som las byung ba'i 'od zer reg bya shin tu tsha ba de phog pas/ 'od zer dkar po rnams dum bur 'thor zhing 'khor ba la sems gtad la/ ya ma rā dza'i yid bzlas cung zad bya/ de nas gsang gnas kyi 'khor lo yig 'bru dang bcas pa thams cad 'od zer dang 'dres par gyur te/ de rnams rtsa'i bu ga nas brgyud de/ rdo rje'i rked pa'i nyi dkyil sngags 'phreng dang bcas pa la reg pas 'od zer dmar po 'bar zhing 'phro ba drag tu 'khor ba la sems gtad la/ hrīḥṣ+tiḥyid bzlas cung zad bya/ nyi dkyil sngags phreng dang bcas pa yang 'od zer dang 'dres te/ de rnams rtsa'i bu ga nas brgyud/ rdo rje'i mgul ba'i rdo rje sngags 'phreng dang bcas pa reg pas 'od zer sngon po 'bar zhing 'phro ba drag tu 'khor ba sems gtad la/ ya mān+ta ka'i yid bzlas cung zad bya/ de na rdo rje sngags 'phreng dang bcas pa yang 'od zer dang po 'dres te/ de rnams rtse'i bu gnas brgyud rdo rje nor bu'i thig le dmar po sngags 'phreng dang bcas pa la reg pas/ 'od zer sna tshogs 'phro zhing 'khor ba la sems gtad la/ a kar+ṣa ya sogs kyi yid bzlas cung zad bya/ de nas nor bu nas gsang gnas kyi bar du a ā/ i ī/ u ū/ e ai/ o au/ aṃ aḥ zhes pa'i yi ge bcu gnyis po rnams kha dog dkar po/ mu tig gi 'phreng ba bstar la brgyus pa lta bu zhig bsgom/ rlung phy-ir bus la dbugs thengs gcig gam yang na yi ge re re la dbugs thengs re re lta bu yang byas te/ gang na yang a yig la sogs pa'i sgra dang bcas a stong 'dren bya zhing*/ 'od zer sna tshogs pa a la thim/ a ā la thim/ rim pa'i gsang gnas su aṃ āḥl lhan gyis thim pas/ 'od zer sna tshogs pa 'phros te lus thams cad gang bar mos/

de nas rlung rngub la kha sbyor du bzung bas/ lus kyi phyi nas me lce lhab kyis 'bar bar bsam/ de nas gsus pa phyir bskyed cing*/ ro stod kyi cha yang ldir byas la/ lus g.yas su bskor ba dang*/ g.yon du bskor ba dang*/ ro stod g.yas su gcu pa dang/ g.yon du gcu pa dang*/ lus thams cad sprugs pa ste/ de rnams lan gsum gsum byas pas me lce yang shin tu 'bar bar gyur te/ lus kyi stangs stabs dang mthun par g.yas su ches cher 'bar ba la sogs par bsam mo/ /'di mtshan ma gyen bsgreng gi yan lag tu sbyor ba ste/ gsang gnas la sogs pa'i gnas bzhi po lte ba la sogs pa'i 'khor lo bzhi dang gnad gcig pa zhig yod pas/ 'khor lo bzhi dang 'brel ba'i dga' bzhi'i yas babs dang*/ mas brtan gyi rim pas ye shes yang skye bar 'gyur ba yin no/ /༈ rwa sgrub pa ni/ rang 'jigs byed du gsal ba'i rwa gnyis hrīḥlas byung ba'i rwa rno zhing mi bzad pa ri rab la sogs pa yang bshig par nus pa/ me lce 'bar ba hrīḥs mtshan pa zhig tu gyur par dmigs la/ oṃ hrīḥkruṃ bruṃ sruṃ s+t+ruṃ hūṃ gaḥzhes pa bzla/ grangs bsnyen khri phrag gcig go /༈ sdigs mdzub sgrub pa ni/ rang gi lag pa g.yas g.yon sdigs mdzub byas la/ de nyid hūṃ nag po me 'bar ba las byung ba'i sdigs mdzub hūṃ gis mtshan pa/ g.yas pa la rtsa ba nas rim pa bzhin du oṃ hi hī ha hā hi hī swāhā/ zhes pa dang*/ g.yon pa la rtse mo nas rim pa bzhin du oṃ zhes pa la sogs pa'o/ /de rnams la dmigs pa gtad la sdigs mdzub 'cha' bzhin du/ sngags de nyid grangs bsnyen khri phrag gcig bzla'o/ /oṃ hi hi ha ha he he badz+ra tardza sā dha ya sā dha ya swāhā/ zhes pa yang ci rigs bzla'o/ /༈ lta stangs sgrub pa ni/ rang nyid 'jigs byed du gsal ba'i spyan gsum gyi 'bras bu stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las phaṭa nag po las byung ba'i rab tu 'bar ba'i spyan phaṭa kyis mtshan pa la/

spyan g.yas g.yon gnyis la sngags 'bru drug gis spras par dmigs la/ oṃ ma me ma mi ma mu swāhā/ zhes grangs bsnyen khri phrag gcig bzla/ de nas/ oṃ ma me ma mi ma mu badz+ra tiṣ+ti sā dha ya sā dha ya swāhā/ zhes pa ci rigs bzla'o/ /༈ zhal dgu sgrub pa ni/ rang nyid rdo rje 'jigs byed zhal phyag yongs rdzogs su gsal ba'i ma he'i zhal thog mar stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las slar yang bhaṃ las ma he'i zhal gyi dpral bar bhaṃ yig gis mtshan pa'i zhig gsal btab la/ oṃ ya mān+ta ka badz+ra bhai ra ba bhaṃ swāhā/ zhes pa'am/ hūṃ phaṭa ces ji ltar rigs pa sbyor la/ grangs bsnyen khri phrag gcig gcig bzla'o/ /de'i rigs 'gre bar byas te/ srin zhal gyi sa bon bha dang*/ sngags ni/ oṃ ya mān+ta ka badz+ra bhai ra wa bha swāhā/ zhes pa dang*/ steng zhal gyi sa bon bhi/ sngags kyang hrag tu bcug pa ma gtogs sngar bzhin/ g.yas zhal sngon po'i sa bon bhu/ sngags kyang sa bon gyi khyad par ma gtogs 'dra/ g.yas zhal gnyis pa dmar po'i sa bon bhai/ sngags kyang sa bon gyi khyad par ma gtogs 'dra/ g.yas zhal gsum pa ser po'i sa bon bho/ sngags kyang sa bon gyi khyad par ma gtogs sngar bzhin/ g.yon zhal dang po dkar po'i sa bon bhau/ sngags kyang sa bon hrag tu bcug pa ma gtogs 'dra/ g.yon zhal gnyis pa dud kha'i sa bon bhaṃ/ sngags kyang sa bon gyi khyad par ma gtogs 'dra/ g.yon zhal gsum pa nag po'i sa bon bhaḥ sngags kyang oṃ ya mān+ta ka badz+ra bhai ra wa bhaḥswāhā/ zhes pa'am/ hūṃ phaṭa ces pa gang rung ngo*/ /thams cad kyang grangs bsnyen khri phrag re re bzla'o/ /zhal dgu po thams cad la yang zhal so so stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las sa bon so so las/ zhal de dang de'i dpral ba rang rang gi sa bon gyis mtshan pa la dmigs nas/ sngags so so bzla zhing*/ 'di dag thams cad la snying po'i sngags kyis byin rlabs bya'o/ /de yan chad kyis bsnyen pa dang rjes su 'brel ba'i zhal gdams mtha' dag song nas/

de'i rjes su nyer sgrub bam bsnyain pa chung ngu'i lag len ni/ thog mar bgegs gtor/ de nas spyi gtor dang*/ gzhi bdag gtor ma rnams btang la/ sa blang*/ de nas mngon rtogs bsgom la bzlas pa ci rigs bya zhing*/ yungs dkar dang thal ba la yang sngags kyis btab cing*/ ya mān+ta ka'i sngags kyis sna drangs la/ bdud rtsi 'khyil ba'i sngags drag tu 'don bzhin pas/ sa gzhi la yungs dkar dang*/ thal ba gtor ro/ /de nas sa'i lha mo lhag par gnas par bya zhing*/ de'i rjes su bum pa bsgrub par bya'o/ /de nas thig tshon byin brlab ni/ thig skud bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las ya mān+ta ka'i sngags kyi phung por gyur bar bsam la/ ya mān+ta ka mang du bzla zhing hrīḥṣ+tiḥyang ci rigs pa bzla'o/ /rdul tshon bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las ya ma rā dza'i sngags kyi phung por gyur par dmigs la/ ya ma rā dza mang du bzla zhing*/ hrīḥṣ+tiḥyang ci rigs bzla'o/ /de nas las thig dang*/ ye thig gi dbye ba mi dgos shing*/ rang nyid 'jigs byed dang las kyi rdo rje yin na 'jigs byed phyag gnyis pa dang*/ sgrub grogs rig ma lta bu yin na rdo rje ro langs mar bsgom la las thig btab/ de nas sngags bzla bzhin pas dkyil 'khor 'bri'o/ /'di dag gi skabs su sgrub po gcig gis sbyin sreg bya zhing gcig gis gtor ma gtong ngo*/ /de lta bu'i mi 'grub na/ rang nyid kyi drug cu rtsa bzhi dang bcas pa'i gtor ma rgyas pa zhig dang*/ sbyin sreg rgyas pa zhig bya'o/ / de yang rdul tshon gyi rgyu ni dur khrod kyi so phag la sogs pa las 'grub na bya ba yin kyang*/ de lta bu 'grub dka' bas sha chen dang khrag la sogs pa bsres/ sgrub pa'i skabs 'dir zhag mang por 'jog dgos pa'i phyir rdul mtshon mi gsal bar 'gyur bas chu tshon lta bus bris na yang shin tu legs/ dkyil 'khor ni 'grub na mtshan nyid yongs rdzogs dang*/

ma 'grub na rtsig pa yan chad bris la/ nang du lha snam sogs legs par bris/ pha gu dang rta babs la sogs pa dang*/ sna tshogs rdo rje pad rwa nyi ma la sogs pa spangs pa'i phyi rol tu dur khrod legs par bris/ de ltar dkyil 'khor rgyas bsdus ji ltar rigs pa bri ba las/ rgyas pa'i phyogs la rtsig pa yan chad bris zin pa dang*/ mtshan ma rnams 'god dgos pa yin no/ /de nas dkyil 'khor dang gdan dang phyag mtshan la sogs pa sbyangs pa byas la/ de rjes gdan dang mtshan ma rnams dgod pa yin pa las/ 'grub na phyag mtshan mtha' dag 'bur dod du bri/ de lta bu ma 'grub na gzhan rnams bris ma dang*/ gtso bo dang*/ ro langs brgyad kyi phyag mtshan rnams 'bur dod du nges par bya'o/ /de yang thun mong ba tsam la gtso bo'i mtshan ma gri gug lags kyang*/ thun mong ma yin pa'i zab mo'i phyogs la/ gtso bo dang*/ ro langs brgyad kar gyi phyag mtshan ral gri'o/ /de yang lcags sam shing lta bu la byas te/ gtso bo'i de cung zad che ba dang*/ gzhan rnams de las cung zad kyis chung bar bya ba yin no/ /gdan yang mi ro yongs rdzogs kyi gzugs brnyan shog bu'am ras lta bu la bya/ yang na bag zan nam 'jim pa lta bu la sha chen dang*/ gri khrag lta bu bsres la ro'i gzugs su bya'o/ /oṃ hūṃ hāḥ zhes pa brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas la gtso bo'i gdan bkod/ oṃ pre ta ūlka ya hūṃ phaṭa/ ces nyer gcig tsam bzlas la shar gyi gdan bkod/ de nas/ oṃ pre ta bi mān+ta ka hūṃ phaṭa/ ces pa nyer gcig tsam bzlas la lho'i gdan bkod/ oṃ pre ta dz+wa la hūṃ phaṭa/ ces pa nyer gcig tsam bzlas la nub kyi gdan bkod/ oṃ k+ṣi pra pre ta ut+pa ṭa hūṃ phaṭa/ ces pa nyer gcig tsam bzlas la byang gi gdan bkod/ de nas oṃ hūṃ laṃ hā/ zhes pa nyer gcig tsam re bzlas te/ mtshams kyi gdan rnams bkod la/ bkod grub pa dang*/ slar yang brtan pa'i phyir du gtso bo'i gdan gyi sngags bdun tsam re dang*/
