'khor gy-i gdan bkod pa'i sngags rnams gsum tsam re bzla'o/ /phyags mtshan 'god pa ni/ snying po brgya rtsa dang*/ gzhan gnyis ci rigs bzlas la/ gtso bo'i phyag mtshan bkod/ 'khor rnams la/ oṃ hūṃ hrī ṭi ṣaḥ zhes pa nyer gcig tsam re bzlas la/ phyag mtshan rnams rim pa bzhin du bkod/ slar yang byin rlabs brtan pa'i phyir du gtso bo la bdun tsam dang*/ 'khor rnams la gsum tsam re bzla'o/ /de nas rdul tshon lhag ma rnams legs par bris la/ mchod gtor rnams bsham la thog mar bdag bskyed dang*/ de nas mdun bskyed dkyil 'khor sgrub mchod bzhin du byas la/ ye shes spyan 'dren dbang bskur rgyas btab rnams grub mtshams su 'og nas 'byung ba'i sngags so sos gtso bo la nyer gcig tsam dang*/ 'khor rnams la bdun tsam re bzlas la byin gyis brlabs/ de nas mchod 'phreng sogs dkyil chog nas 'byung ba ltar byas shing*/ de nas gtor ma phul la bzlas pa bya ba yin pa las/ de yang 'jig rten pa'i lho dkyil 'khor gyi shar phyogs nas/ oṃ badz+ra uṅga ṭa sa mā ya pra be sha ya hūṃ/ zhes pas sgo phye/ de nas snying po'i mthar oṃ badz+ra pra be sha ya hūṃ/ zhes pas dkyil 'khor gyi shar phyogs nas zhugs te/ re mig gi nang mgo bo'i mtshan ma'i steng du/ rang nyid 'jigs byed kyi rnam pas gnas par bsam la bzlas par bya'o/ /'di la gshin rje ltar sgrub pa dang*/ srin po ltar sgrub pa dang*/ dbang phyug ltar sgrub pa dang*/ mgon po ltar sgrub pa ste bzhi yod pa las/ gshin rje ltar bsgrub pa la/ pho brgyad ral gri dang thod khrag 'dzin pa/ mo brgyad kyi ngo bo ro langs kyi bzhon pa la bzhon par bsgom la/ sngags ni/ ya ma me da k+ṣe oṃ hūṃ hrī ṭi sha /zhes pa ni gshin rje pho brgyad kyi sa bon dang*/ bzhon pa brgyad kyi sngags ni/ oṃ badz+ra tsartsa ya tsartsa ya hūṃ phaṭa/ ces pa'i mjug la phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad kyi gdan 'god pa'i sngags rnams btags la bzla'o/

/srin po ltar sgrub pa ni/ srin po pho brgyad ni/ ral gri dang thod khrag 'dzin pa/ srin mo brgyad kyi ngo bo ni/ ro langs brgyad kyi bzhon pa la bzhon par bsgom la oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa sa bha k+ṣa ya i ti hūṃ phaṭa/ ces pa'i mthar/ oṃ hūṃ hrī ṭi ṣa/ zhes pa btags la bzla'o/ /ro'i bzhon pa'i sngags ni/ oṃ ru ru ro ru hūṃ phaṭa/ ces pa'i mthar phyogs mtshams kyi gdan brgyad 'god pa'i sngags btags la bzla'o/ /dbang phyug ltar sgrub pa ni/ ro langs chen po brgyad gṛ thod 'dzin pa/ ro'i gdan la gnas par bsgom/ sngags ni/ oṃ bha hūṃ phaṭa/ de bzhin du/ bhi bhu bhe bhai bho bhau bhaḥ zhes pa sa bon gyi mgo bor/ oṃ dang mjug tu hūṃ phaṭa/ zhes pa sbyar/ de dag re re'i mthar/ oṃ hūṃ hrī ṭi ṣa/ zhes pa btags la bzla ba ni pho brgyad kyi sngags dang*/ mo brgyad kyi sngags ni/ oṃ hrīḥha hūṃ phaṭa/ ces pa'i mthar gdan brgyad kyi sngags rnams rim pa bzhin btags la bzla'o/ /mgon po ltar sgrub pa ni/ ro gdan gyi steng du mgon po brgyad ky-i gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa/ sku mdog nag por bsgom la/ sngags ni/ oṃ mahā kā la hūṃ phaṭa/ ces pa'i mthar/ oṃ hūṃ hrī ṭi sha /zhes pa btags la bzla'o/ / mgon po brgyad yab rkyang kho na yin la/ de yang sgrub lugs bzhi po de phyir rang gi mos pa dang bstun pa'am brtag pa la ji ltar babs pa gcig bya ba yin kyang gshin rje ltar sgrub pa gtso che bar mdzad do/ /de yang bzlas pa'i gtso bo/ rtsa sngags dang*/ snying po dang*/ nye snying rnams la bya ba yin zhing*/ mjug tu 'khor sngags rnams kyang ci rigs bzla zhing*/ thun gyi mjug tu gtor ma 'bul lo/ /yang na gshin rje pho dang*/ srin po pho dang*/ dbang phyug pho rnams bzhon pa'i tshul du ro langs pho brgyad du byas la/ mo'i tshul du sgrub na yang rung ngo*/ /bzlas pa'i dmigs pa ni/ rang nyid 'jigs byed du gsal ba'i thugs ka dang*/

mdun bskyed kyi thugs kar rgyu'i 'jam dpal/ de'i thugs kar nyi ma la hūṃ gi mthar sngags kyi 'phreng bas bskor bar dmigs la/ rang gi snying ga'i sngags 'phreng las 'od zer 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang sems rnams mchod pas mnyes par byas/ sems can kyi sdig sgrib sbyangs/ sangs rgyas kyi byin rlabs rnams 'od zer gyi rnam pas spyan drangs te/ rang gi snying ga'i sngags 'phreng la thim/ yang snying kha'i sngags 'phreng las 'od zer dpag tu med pa spros/ mdun bskyed kyi thugs ka'i sngags 'phreng la phog pas/ 'od zer gyi rtse mo las mchod pa dpag tu med pa sprul te/ mchod pas mnyes par byas/ 'od zer rnams tshur 'dus rang gi snying ga'i sngags 'phreng la thim par bsam/ de lta bu'i dmigs pa sngags brgya tshar re la bskyar gyin bya'o/ /mthar thun 'jog khar/ rang gi snying kha'i sngags 'phreng 'od zer 'bar ba las ngo bo sangs rgyas kyi byin rlabs/ rnam pa 'od zer dkar po'i gong bu zhig chad de/ snying ga'i stod tsam du gnas par bsam la/ rang gi snying ga'i sngags 'phreng gi byin rlabs brtan pa'i phyir yi ge brgya pa lan gsum brjod/ de nas 'phreng ba dkyil 'khor dbus sam mdun du bzhag la/ 'od zer gyi gong bu de nyid rang gi kha sgo'am/ spyi bo'am snying ga gang rung nas thon te mdun bskyed kyi thugs ka'i sngags 'phreng la thim pas byin rlabs phul bar bsam/ sgrub pa zla drug byed na zla ba lnga'i ring la dmigs pa de nyid kho na bya zhing*/ zla ba drug pa la thun gyi mjug tu sngags 'phreng skor lnga tsam gyi rang la mdun bskyed kyi thugs ka'i sngags 'phreng las sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs rnams 'od zer gyi rnam pas byung ste/ rang gi snying ga'i sngags 'phreng la thim pas bkrag mdangs gzi brjid rgyas par bsam mo/ /sgrub pa zla ba lnga dang bzhi dang gsum la sogs pa byed na yang de'i rigs 'gre/

zla ba phyed gnyis byed na zla ba gcig gong gi dmigs pa de ka byed cing*/ zla ba phyed kyi ring la mdun bskyed las byin rlabs len pa'i dmigs pa de bya zhing*/ 'khor rnams las kyang dngos grub len pa'i dmigs pa bya'o/ /mthar sngags kyi nor bu 'bul ba yang bya'o/ /dngos grub len pa'i dmigs pa byed pa'i skabs kyi bzla bya'i sngags gsum po gang rung zhig gi mthar/ oṃ mahā badz+ra bhai ra wa sarba sid+dhi da ya ka ṭaṃ hūṃ kuṃ draṃ ṭa/

<dpe la lar dh+waṃ zer ba yod/> ces pa bzla zhing*/ 'khor rnams kyang rang rang gi sngags kyi mthar/ oṃ hūṃ tsaṃ sarba sid+dhi da ya ka hūṃ/ zhes pa'ang bzla'o/ /thun gyi mthar rang nyid dkyil 'khor nas phyir thon te/ dge ba bsngo zhing*/ gtor ma 'bul la spyaud lam la 'jug go /de yang 'grub na thun re re bzhin sbyin sreg byed pa yin kyang*/ de bzhin mi 'grub na thun ji ltar rigs pa gcig la nges par bya dgos shing*/ ci ste de yang ma lcogs na nyer sgrub grub mtshams su zhag 'ga' zhig sprel te bya'o/ /nyer sgrub kyi skabs 'dir ci ste rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor 'bri ba ma thub na/ phyag mtshan rnams gong bzhin bkod pa'i dbus su/ ras bris shing lta bu zhig la brten nas bkram mo/ /phyag mtshan so so'i sngags ni/ de yang re mig brgyad kyi nang gi mgo bo la sogs pa brgyad kyi sngags ni/ oṃ āḥhrīḥhūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ āḥṣ+tiḥhūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ āḥbi hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ āḥkri hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ āḥta hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ āḥ.a hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ān hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ āḥn hūṃ phaṭa/ shar gyi lha snam gyi mtshan ma drug gi sngags ni/ oṃ āḥya hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ āḥm hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ āḥr hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ āḥdza hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ āḥs hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ āḥd hūṃ phaṭa/ lho'i lha snam gyi mtshan ma drug gi sngags ni/ oṃ āḥya hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ āḥme hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ āḥdo hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ aḥru hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ āḥṇa hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ aḥyo hūṃ phaṭa/ nub kyi lha snam gyi mtshan ma drug gi sngags ni/ oṃ āḥya hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ āḥd hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ āḥya hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ āḥni hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ āḥr hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ āḥya hūṃ phaṭa/ byang gi lha snam gyi mtshan ma drug gi sngags ni/ oṃ āḥya hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ āḥk+ṣe hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ āḥya hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ āḥts+tsha hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ āḥni hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ āḥr hūṃ phaṭa/ ces pa rnams so/

/ro langs brgyad kyi sngags ni/ oṃ āḥya hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ āḥmān hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ āḥta hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ āḥka hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ āḥhūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ āḥhūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ āḥphaṭa hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ āḥphaṭa hūṃ phaṭa/ ces pa rnams so/ /gdan brgyad kyi sngags ni/ oṃ āḥme hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ āḥya hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ āḥd hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ āḥya hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ āḥk+ṣe hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ āḥya hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ āḥm hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ āḥya hūṃ phaṭa/ ces pa rnams so/ /gong gi byin gyi brlabs pa'i skabs dang*/ bzlas pa'i skabs gnyis kar du ro langs brgyad dang*/ gdan brgyad la sogs pa so so'i sngags gong du bshad zin pa 'di dang*/ 'di skabs kyi sngags rnams rgya nyis rim gy-i tshul gyis gnyis kar bzla bar bya'o/ /phyag mtshan so so'i sngags rnams kyang byin gyis rlobs pa dang*/ bzlas pa'i gnas skabs gnyis kar bzla bar bya'o/ /de yan chad kyis nyer sgrub kyi skor rnams song nas/ /༈ da ni sgrub pa'i rim pa rnams bshad par bya ste/ dkyil 'khor 'bri tshul sogs nas bzung*/ mdun bskyed kyi dkyil 'khor gyi nang du 'jug pa'i bar nyer sgrub ji lta ba bzhi las/ yum bzhi khar bsgom na phyogs kyi re mig bzhi'i mtshan ma'i mdun du thod pa bzhi bri/ yang na dbyangs can ma dang*/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma gang rung zhig bsgoms na/ shar phyogs kyi re mig gi mdun du mtshan ma thod pa gcig bkod/ dkyil 'khor sgrub pa'i gnas skabs su yang yum bzhi khar bsgoms na/ shar du tsar tsi ka /lhor phag mo/ nub tu dbyangs can ma/ byang du go ri rnams dgra nag nas 'byung ba bzhin bsgom la byin gyis brlabs pa dang*/ bzlas pa'i gnas skabs su yang*/ oṃ mo hā ra ti hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ pi tsu na rā ti hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ra ga rā ti hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra rā ti hūṃ phaṭa/ ces pa bzla/ dbyangs can ma'am rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma gang rung zhig bsgoms na/

dbyangs can ma'i sngags oṃ pu tsu sogs dang*/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i sngags/ oṃ badz+ra ḍā ki nī hūṃ phaṭa/ ces pa bzla'o/ /de nas rang nyid gtso bo dang dbyer med du gyur te/ rang dkyil 'khor gyi dbus na gtso bo'i tshul du gnas par mos la bzlas pa la 'jug par bya'o/ /bzlas pa'i dmigs pa ni/ rang nyid kyi thugs kar rgyu'i 'jam dpal/ de'i thugs kar nyi ma la hūṃ gi mthar sngags kyis bskor bar dmigs la/ de las 'od zer sna tshogs dpag tu med pa spros phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' thams cad mchod pas mnyes par byas/ sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib sbyangs/ 'od zer slar 'dus rang la thim par bsam mo/ /de ltar sgrub pa zla drug byed na/ zla ba lnga'i ring la dmigs pa de dag bya zhing*/ zla ba drug pa la dngos grub len pa'i dmigs pa bya ste de yang thun mjug la snying po la sogs pa'i mthar/ oṃ mahā badz+ra bhai ra wa sogs gtso bo'i dngos grub len pa'i sngags dang*/ 'khor so so'i sngags kyi mthar oṃ hūṃ tsaṃ sogs 'khor gyi dngos grub len pa'i bzlas pa yang cung zad bya zhing*/ rang gi snying ga'i sngags 'phreng 'od zer 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' thams cad sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs thams cad 'od zer kyi rnam par spyan drangs te/ rang nyid kyi thugs ka'i sngags 'phreng dang*/ 'khor thams cad kyi thugs ka'i sngags 'phreng la phog pas bkrag mdangs gzi brjid rgyas par bsam la/ sngags bzla'o/ /thun mtshams la 'jug pa dang*/ dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo'i thugs ka nas rang nyid rdo rje 'jigs byed phyag gnyis pa'i rnam pas dkyil 'khor nas thon te/ bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'jigs byen chen pos bdag la dngos grub ma lus pa stsal tu gsol/ ces gsol ba btab la/ gtor ma phul lo/ /bsnyen sgrub sbrags ma'i skabs 'dir bar chad 'jug pa'i sgo shin tu che bas/

uṣ+ṇi ṣa'i bsrung bzlog rang nyid kyis srod thun la bya zhing*/ sgrub grogs dam tshig gtsang ba dag gi thun bzhi la sogs par bsrung 'khor sgom du 'jug go /de yan chad kyi sgrub pa'am/ bsnyen sgrub sbrags ma'i zhal gdams rnams song nas/ /༈ da ni sgrub chen gyi zhal gdams rnams bstan par bya ste/ dkyil 'khor 'bri ba dang*/ sgrub tshul sogs gong bzhin las/ gtso bo'i mtshan ma ral gri'i mdun du thod snod la sogs par mar khu'am/ chang la sogs pa la dam rdzas btab pa'am yang na thod pa la sogs pa'i snod kyi nang du bdud rtsi ril bu lta bu zhig dngos grub kyi rdzas su bzhag /bdag bskyed grub mtshams su thod pa dang*/ de'i nang gi rdzas gnyis car la bgegs bskrad pa dang*/ a mṛ ta dang ya mān+ta ka la sogs pas mang du bsngags shing*/ mdun bskyed sgrub pa la 'jug cing thod pa'i nang gi rdzas dang bcas pa mdun bskyed kyi lte ba'i nang du gnas pa la bsangs sbyangs/ de yang dbus su hūṃ dang*/ de'i mthar ya mān+ta kas bskor bar bsam/ de yongs su gyur pa las/ khu ba yin na bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin du gyur pa'i dbus su rdo rje 'jigs byed bskyed pa yin zhing*/ gong bu'i rdzas yin na de shin tu che bar gyur pa'i gtso bo'i phyogs su sa bon hūṃ las rdo rje 'jigs byed phyag gnyis pa chung ngu zhig bskyed do/ /de nas gtor ma 'bul ba'i bar gong bzhin byas la/ rang nyid rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi rnam pas dkyil 'khor gyi sgo nas zhugs te gtso bo dang rang gnyis su med par gyur pa'i lte bar thod nang gi rdzas kyi nang gi 'jigs byed dang bcas pa gnas par bsam la/ sngags gsum po gang rung gi mthar/ dngos grub len pa'i sngags btags la bzla/ dmigs pa ni/ rang gi thugs ka'i sngags 'phreng las 'od zer gyi tshogs dpag tu med pa 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad kyi byin rlabs rnams sngags dang*/

de yang 'od zer 'bar zhing bdud rtsi 'dzag pa'i rnam pa can dpag tu med pa'i rnam par spyan drangs te/ rang gi thugs ka'i sngags 'phreng la thim bkrag mdangs rgyas par bsam zhing*/ de las sngags dang 'od zer bdud rtsi 'dzag pa'i rnam pa can gyi byin rlabs kyi cha shas zhig /lte ba'i rdzas nang gi 'jigs byed la thim pas bkrag mdangs rgyas par bsam mo/ / thun mtshams la 'jug pa'i skabs su rang nyid phyag gnyis pa'i rnam pas phyir phyung ste/ gtor ma 'phul ba sogs bya'o/ /de yang sgrub chen gyi skabs 'dir grub na zhag bdun la sogs pa byed pa'i tshe/ mtshan mo gnyid mi log par bzlas pa bya ba yin kyang*/ ci ste ma 'grub na zhag drug gi ring la mtshan phyed kyi bar du bzlas pa bya zhing*/ de nas dkyil 'khor gyi nang nas thon te/ yi dam gyi gtor ma 'bul ba dang*/ phyogs skyong la yang drug cu rtsa bzhi phul la/ de nas rang nyid 'jigs byed phyag gnyis pa'i nga rgyal gyis lag pa g.yas su ral gri dang*/ g.yon du thod pa chang gis gang ba thogs la sgrub khang gi phyi rol tu phyin te/ sha khrag dang bcas pa'i gtor ma drug cu rtsa bzhi la/ thod pa'i nang gi chang nas blug la gtor ma rgyas par btang la/ tshams rngams dang bcas pas/ hrīḥṣ+tiḥdang*/ hūṃ hūṃ ha ha ho ho he hai zhes pa 'don bzhin pas/ dkyil 'khor la bskor ba byas la/ de nas badz+ra ud gha ṭa ya sa mā ya pra be sha ya hūṃ/ zhes pas dkyil 'khor gyi sgo nas zhugs te/ gtso bo'i sku'i mdun du 'dug par mos la/ bdag la dngos grub ma lus pa stsal tu gsol/ zhes gsol ba drag tu btab bo/ /de nas gnyid la sogs pa log na dkyil 'khor nas phyir thon te/ sgrub khang nyid du nyal lo/ /zhag bdun pa la/ nam gong gi sbyin sreg dang*/ gtor ma 'bul ba dang*/ phyi rol tu drug cu rtsa bzhi gtong ba/ dkyil 'khor la bskor ba byed cing*/ nang du zhugs la dngos grub stsol bar gsol ba btab la/

rang nyid gtso bo dang dbyer med du gyur par bsam la bzlas pa bya/ de nas slar yang nam langs du nye ba na phyag gnyis pa'i rnam pas phyir thon te/ 'grub na sbyin sreg dang*/ gtor ma gtong ba sogs bya/ ma 'grub na mchod pa gsar ba bshams la byin gyis brlabs la/ mchod pa rnams phul la/ dkyil 'khor gyi nang du zhugs te/ dngos grub stsol bar gsol ba drag la yun ring bar btab pas/ mdun bskyed rdo rje 'jigs byed kyis dngos grub kyi rdzas rang la gnang bar brtsams pa na/ rang nyid kyis kyang*/ na maḥte hūṃ/ na maḥme hūṃ/ na mo na maḥhūṃ/ zhes phyag 'tshal zhing hrīḥṣ+tiḥbazlas pas rang la dngos grub kyi rdzas te stsal ba la lag pa gnyis kyis blangs la/ sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub thams cad du mos pas rdzas te bza' ba'am/ btung bas dngos grub thams cad thob par mos/ de nas dkyil 'khor gshegs gsol bya ba yin pa las/ nyer sgrub dang*/ sgrub pa'i skabs su ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang la bsdu ba yin la/ sgrub chen gyi skabs 'dir mdun bskyed kyi lha tshogs thams cad rang la oṃ āḥhūṃ dang yo ga shud+dha sogs bzla bzhin pas rang la bsdu'o/ /de la sgrub pa po dngos grub 'grub pa'i skal ba dang ldan pa dag gis ril bu mig sman ro langs sogs kyi dngos grub rnams kyang tshul 'di kho nas cho gas sgrub pa yin la/ da lta las dang po pa rnams kyis mos pa lam byed kyi tshul gyis sgrub pa yin no/ /gzhan dag rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi rnal 'byor gyis ril bu mig sman la sogs pa'i dngos grub sgrub pa yang dgra nag nas 'byung ba'i cho gas sgrub dgos so/ /zhes smra ba ni rtogs bdun nas bshad pa'i man ngag zab mo 'di lta bu dang mi ldan zhing ma rtogs par zad do/ /de dag gis ni thun mong ma yin pa'i zhal gyi gdams pa rnams bshad zin to/ /༈ /'dir smras pa/ zab yang chos kyi gting mtha' mi mngon pa/

/thams cad mkhyen cing gzigs pa'i ye shes yul/ /gang la gang dga' de de'i gdul bya la/ /bskal ba'i rim par ston 'di rgyal ba'i srol/ /de phyir snying la zhe sdang me 'bar ba'i/ /gdug can gang de 'dul ba'i thabs kyis 'phrul/ /brjod bya rab zab rjod byed rdo rje'i tshig /rtog bdun 'jam pa'i rdo rjes nye bar bstan/ / gang de'i dgongs don bla med pa/ /mthu stobs dpa' bo rwa lo yis/ /man ngag snyan nas snyan brgyud pa/ /mkhas rlom phal gyi ming tsam yang*/ /rna ba'i lam du ma grags pa/ /u dum ba ra'i me tog ltar/ /shin tu rnyed dka'i lam bzang 'di/ /bla ma'i drin las legs rnyed pa/ /brjed pa 'jigs nas yi ger bris/ / byis pa'i blo ni don la rmongs/ /de phyir nor dang 'khrul ba'i cha/ /'di la gang byung de dang de/ /rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i tshogs la bshags/ /'dir 'bad dge ba thob de yis/ /'gro rnams 'jam pa'i rdo rje yi/ /go 'phang bla med thob par shog /ces pa'ang rje btsun thams cad mkhyen pa kun dga' snying po'i gsung rgyud las byung ba/ shākya'i dge slong ye shes rgya mtshos zin bris su byas pa'o/ / dge'o// // bkra shis// de nas nang mchod ni/ dmigs pa byin rlabs rnams rtogs bdun las ma gsungs kyang*/ gdong drug gi rgyud las dngos su gsungs pas/ thod pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du sha lnga dbus dang phyogs bzhir na ga ku da ha sha lnga'i ngo bo yin par bsam/ ya kle ma me da lnga gshin rje rigs lnga'i ngo bor mos/ mtshams bzhir dbus dang lngar/ byang sems dri chen/ dri chu/ klad pa/ rak+ta rnams rim bzhin/ dza sa ma rus hūṃ mtshan pa yum tsar tsi ka /phag mo/ dbyangs can ma/ go ri bzhi'i ngo bor mos/ rang gi thugs kar 'od 'phros/ de dag la phog pas de thams cad zhi zhing 'dres pa'i nang du sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte ba'i steng mi bskyod pa sngon po rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pa rdo rje dbyings kyi dbang phyug ma la 'khyud pa/

shar rwa'i steng du rnam snang dkar po 'khor lo 'dzin pa/ spyan ma la/ lhor rin 'byung ser po/ mā ma kī/ nub tu 'od dpag med dmar po/ dbyangs can ma byang rwa'i steng du don yod grub pa ljang gu ral gri 'dzin pa/ yum sgrol ma la 'khyud pa/ thams cad g.yas rang rang gi phyag mtshan/ g.yon pa thams cad dril bu 'dzin pa'o/ /yab yum snyoms 'jug byas pa'i sgras sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad spyan drangs/ yab kyi zhal du zhugs/ byang chub sems kyi bdud rtsir zhu/ yum gyi pad+mar babs/ yab yum rnams rjes chags kyi rol pas bdud rtsi zhu/ rdzas rnams la thim pas/ bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur par bsam/ thams cad la dge zhing bkra shis par gyur cig / mes po'i shul bzhag las/ tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum/tā ra nā tha'i gsung thor bu'i skor/ - PAGE 276 -- PAGE 279 -- PAGE 275 -
